body: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) is pushing to restrict added sucrose and fructose in food products formulated for infants up to six months of age. This was outlined in its newly published draft amendment to the nation’s Food Safety and Standards (Foods for Infant Nutrition) Regulations, 2020. The 2026 draft document was published in the Gazette of India and aims to strengthen the existing regulatory framework by ensuring that infant nutrition products are formulated in accordance with “age-appropriate nutritional requirements.” In the drafted amendment, the proposed provision states that “sucrose and fructose shall not be added in the products intended for infants up to the age of six months.” “The initiative complements established public health recommendations promoting exclusive breastfeeding during the first six months of life,” states the FSSAI. “By strengthening standards for infant nutrition products, the proposed amendment seeks to support appropriate infant feeding practices while encouraging manufacturers to adopt formulations that prioritize the specific nutritional requirements of young infants.” The update comes at on the heels of growing public scrutiny of the nutritional profile and constitution of infant foods, as one recent study in the US found that 71% of baby foods are classified as ultra-processed foods (UPFs). UPFs tend to lack nutrients in comparison to whole foods and less processed products, while containing more additives and sugar. India’s existing regulations provide comprehensive guidance on nutritional composition, quality, and safety standards for various infant nutrition product categories, the FSSAI highlights. These cover children from birth up to 24 months of age. The current provisions list lactose and glucose polymers as the preferred sources of carbohydrates, while they state that sucrose and/or fructose may be added only when required as a carbohydrate source, subject to prescribed limits. The drafted amendment states that sucrose and fructose shall not be added in the products intended for infants up to the age of six months. The first six months of life represent a critical period for healthy growth and development, which makes receiving the appropriate nutrition particularly important for infants, underscores the FSSAI.

title: 蒙牛悄悄养了三年的特医品牌，终于亮牌了？ - 母婴行业观察
summary: 蒙牛推出特医品牌特一亿诺，专注于婴幼儿罕见病、过敏及成人组件类特医食品，布局差异化市场。该品牌背靠蒙牛全产业链，但面临国外品牌竞争和特医食品监管挑战。对行业从业者意味着需关注特医食品市场发展趋势，重视差异化竞争和全产业链布局。跨境乳企可关注国内特医食品市场潜力，探索细分领域机会。品牌成立于2023年10月，完成主体注册后始终保持低调，直到2026年8月至9月才陆续集中亮相系列产品。
title_zh: 蒙牛悄悄养了三年的特医品牌，终于亮牌了？
body: 伴随着宁敏瑞、萱康安两款特医产品拿到“双首证”，蒙牛孵化的独立特医品牌“特一亿诺”闯入大众视野。 这是一家怎样的企业？同样是做特医，蒙牛和其他乳企布局差异性在哪？本文将逐一拆解，以看清当下国产特医市场现状。 特一亿诺全称上海特一亿诺健康科技有限公司，由蒙牛控股，是完全独立运营的特医子公司。 品牌成立于2023年10月，完成主体注册后始终保持低调，直到2026年8月至9月才陆续集中亮相系列产品。 正式切入市场之后，特一亿诺没有扎堆入局内卷化赛道，没有跟风挤入竞争已经十分激烈的普通早产、无乳糖特配粉赛道，而是 瞄准国内过去供给不足的婴幼儿罕见代谢病、重度食物蛋白过敏、成人术后重症营养支持等刚需细分市场 。 截至2026年9月，特一亿诺已经拿到三款国家注册特医产品，覆盖婴幼儿到成人的不同临床需求。 具体来看，瑞葆安®，针对0-12月龄苯丙酮尿症婴儿，属于罕见病宝宝必需的“生命口粮”；宁敏瑞®，面向0-12月龄重度食物蛋白过敏婴儿，是国产首批新国标婴儿氨基酸配方产品；萱康安®，面向18岁以上需要谷氨酰胺补充的术后、重症康复人群，填补国内该组件配方的国产空白。 在产业布局上，特一亿诺构建了“自研+自有工厂+自主销售”全闭环产业链体系，内蒙古特康瑞工厂为特医专厂专线运营，只生产特殊医学用途配方食品，是国产少数拥有专属特医生产工厂的品牌。 根据灼识咨询公开数据，2024年国内特医食品市场规模为232亿元，预计2029年可以达到531亿元，2024至2029年复合增长率18%。整个市场渗透率仅3%，对比美国市场超40%的渗透率，国内行业整体还处在发展早期阶段。 截至2026年6月，国内累计获批特医食品342款， 外资品牌在部分高壁垒细分品类依旧保持优势，达能纽迪希亚、雀巢等企业依靠较早入局 ，积累大量临床学术资源，国产企业注册产品数量持续提升，但多数集中在婴儿特医板块，成人组件类产品数量偏少。 在这样的行业环境里， 特一亿诺展现出自身差异化 ：背靠蒙牛的产业、资金、供应链实力，同时作为独立特医公司，不受普通快消奶粉业务的束缚；产品上同时布局婴幼儿罕见病、过敏，再加成人组件类特医，打通了“婴儿+成人”两端，这在国产新玩家中并不多见。 但即便如此，但特一亿诺想要站稳脚跟，依然面临不少难题。一方面，国外特医品牌深耕市场多年，在医院渠道、医生认可、大众口碑上积累了深厚优势，用户根深蒂固更信任进口品牌；另一方面，特医食品属于严格监管的特殊食品，不允许大肆广告宣传，只能依靠医院、营养师、专业圈层推广，品牌普及速度慢。同时，特医产品研发投入大、审批周期长，想要持续丰富产品、扩大市场，对品牌的资金和技术都是长期考验。 总的来看，手握多款稀缺持证产品、又背靠蒙牛全产业链支撑的特一亿诺，正站在国产特医起势的节点上，后续动作值得持续关注。 版权声明： 转载母婴行业观察的原创文章，需注明文章来源以及作者名称。公众号转载请联系开白小助手（微信号：zhangxiaoxian1015）。违规转载法律必究。 扫描二维码，第一时间获取母婴行业的资讯和动态。 从此和母婴行业观察建立直接联系。

title_zh: 雀巢Q3营收超1800亿元！婴儿奶粉稳步调整，宠物护理接棒高增长
body: 近日，雀巢发布2026年第三季度及前9个月财报： 三季度集团单季销售额228亿瑞士法郎（折合人民币约1849亿元） ，有机增长率4.0%，其中实际内部增长率（RIG）达2.8%，为2021年以来最好表现，高于分析师预期的3.4%。 这份成绩单，被视为新任首席执行官费耐睿上任一年来的阶段性成果。其中，大中华区连续两个季度的回暖，成为这份答卷里最值得关注的看点。 整体来看，雀巢三季度成效不错，所有大区与全球直管业务的实际内部增长全部转正，新兴市场有机增长6.8%、RIG4.3%；发达市场有机增长2.2%、RIG1.9%。渠道方面，电商有机增长15.3%，占集团总销售额21.6%。 分板块看，雀巢旗下 宠物护理 有机增长5.3%、RIG4.3%，新兴市场宠物护理业务今年至今有机销售额增长约10%， 是增长最快的板块之一 ；食品与零食有机增长5.0%；咖啡有机增长3.4%； 营养业务有机增长0.3%，其中医学营养连续第六个季度提速 ，表现亮眼； 婴儿奶粉业务则处于稳步修复阶段 ，对集团整体有机增长形成一定拖累，相关影响正在逐步收窄。 最受关注的是中国市场 ：大中华区三季度有机增长4.2%，其中RIG3.7%、定价贡献0.5%， 连续第二个季度实现增长 ，一方面源于2025年同期渠道库存调整带来的低基数，另一方面来自核心业务持续改善。雀巢管理层表示，外部市场环境“依然充满挑战”，但包含中国在内的新兴市场，是其重点加码的宠物护理的增长平台。 9月，集团与Yellow Wood Partners达成协议，拟以10亿美元（约8亿瑞郎）出售大众维生素矿物质补充剂（VMS）业务，含自然之宝等7大品牌，预计2027年上半年完成交割。7月，雀巢宣布与Platinum Equity合资设立Peranel，各持50%股权，运营水业务及高端饮料业务，该业务前9个月销售额28亿瑞郎，有机增长7.5%。4月，蓝瓶咖啡资产完成出售。 随着出生人口下行，0-3岁婴幼儿规模持续萎缩， 婴配粉增长早已见顶。乳企不再局限于婴幼儿配方奶粉单一赛道，企业纷纷向外拓展成长空间 。 贝因美借国资入场布局AI智能母婴、女性私护、康养消费等关联赛道；澳优加码运动营养、职场修复、抗衰老；飞鹤布局全生命周期产品与乳原料；伊利全面布局控糖、骨骼、免疫等功能赛道并加码乳原料深加工；蒙牛押注运动营养、特医食品子品牌。 综上来看， 雀巢“聚焦优势、剥离非核心”的战略路径清晰，婴配业务仍处修复阶段，但调整方向明确，宠物与新兴市场正成为新的增长支点。 当婴儿生意见顶，谁能把增量赛道做成新的增长曲线，谁才能熬过周期。雀巢维持全年指引，自由现金流预计超90亿瑞士法郎。对这家百年乳企而言，下一季度的真正考验在于：这份由销量撑起的增长，能否在剥离与聚焦的转型中持续兑现。 版权声明： 转载母婴行业观察的原创文章，需注明文章来源以及作者名称。公众号转载请联系开白小助手（微信号：zhangxiaoxian1015）。违规转载法律必究。 扫描二维码，第一时间获取母婴行业的资讯和动态。 从此和母婴行业观察建立直接联系。

title: 忽然一周｜孩子王旗下丝域美国门店已试营业；盛夏光年完成近5000万A轮融资；雅培分拆全球营养品业务；雀巢、润本、jELLYCAT发布最新财报 - 母婴行业观察
summary: 孩子王旗下丝域美国门店试营业，拓展跨境渠道；盛夏光年获近5000万A轮融资，推动行业发展；雅培分拆全球营养品业务，聚焦核心市场；雀巢、润本、jELLYCAT发布财报，反映市场动态。对从业者意味着，跨境渠道拓展和融资环境改善带来机遇，需关注品牌战略调整和市场表现，把握行业发展趋势。
source_name: Google News·配方注册与监管（中文）
title_zh: 孩子王旗下丝域美国门店已试营业；盛夏光年完成近5000万A轮融资；雅培分拆全球营养品业务；雀巢、润本、jELLYCAT发布最新财报
points: 丝域美国门店试营业
盛夏光年获近5000万A轮融资
雅培分拆全球营养品业务
雀巢等发布财报显示市场动态
body: 本周，母婴行业业务重构与场景细分同步提速，存量竞争下的战略调整更聚焦专业能力与细分市场。 资本与品牌层面，雅培分拆全球营养品业务，多个品牌将进入独立平台；美赞臣中国以系统化方案重构儿童营养品类逻辑。渠道端，双11母婴竞争升温，定制纸尿裤、全龄营养等细分新品密集落地，品牌场景化布局持续加码。 数据与政策层面，乳制品线下延续下行，雀巢大中华区逆势保持增长；政策端，工信部启动消费名品征集，妇幼产品获重点支持，细分品类迎来政策利好。 10月16日，国家市场监督管理总局食品审评中心发布新一批的婴幼儿配方乳粉产品配方注册批件（决定书）邮寄信息，涉及美力源乳业的9款产品。 10月12日、13日，国家市场监督管理总局食品审评中心发布新一批的特殊医学用途配方食品批件（决定书）邮寄信息，涉及冬泽特医、辰欣药业等企业共17款产品。其中有一款婴儿特医食品。 母观说：批件的流向，就是企业战略重心的流向。婴配粉赛道在收缩，特医在扩容，这个趋势已经很清楚了。更值得关注的是国产特医的占比在持续提升，尤其是婴儿特医食品，这个领域过去长期被外资把持，国产每拿下一款批件，都是在啃硬骨头。门槛高、周期长，能持续拿到批件的企业，说明研发投入是真金白银砸进去了，一旦跑通，壁垒也远比婴配粉高。 10月21日，全球营养健康与医疗巨头雅培官宣了一个大动作：将全球营养品业务拆分为一家独立的上市公司。雅培在营养健康领域已有不错的积累，旗下已有Similac（婴配粉品牌）、PediaSure（儿童营养补充剂品牌）、Ensure等全球知名品牌。雅培多年老将Daniel Salvadori将出任新公司的首席执行官。 母观说：这是典型的巨头“聚焦”动作，把承压板块分出去，让核心业务轻装上阵。营养品在雅培四大板块里体量不小，但增长乏力，单独拆出来独立上市，反而能给它独立的估值和决策空间。全球巨头在周期里做这种取舍并不罕见，关键是新公司拿到自主权之后，能不能跑出比“大公司的一个部门”更快的节奏。 10月19日，美赞臣中国发布“AuxoKids科学成长营养系统”，用“1+T+N”三层结构，把儿童营养从“一罐奶粉打天下”拆成配方基底、精细营养支持、场景化解决方案三个层级。“1”——美赞臣多国专利认证的独家长短链益生元组合聚葡萄糖（PDX）和低聚半乳糖（GOS）搭建配方基底；“T”——多种生物活性肽，实现营养精细化；“N”——围绕不同成长阶段与生活场景延伸出的多样化营养方案。美赞臣中国透露，核心儿童奶粉将全面应用这套系统，青少年新系列也在规划中，方向是成长+运动。 母观说：单品逻辑在3岁以后的市场正在失效，这几乎是行业共识。美赞臣正视了一个事实：儿童营养需求分层分场景，一罐奶粉包打天下的逻辑正在失效。方向是对的，但难点在落地：系统化方案对渠道的推介能力要求很高，需要门店愿意推、导购讲得清、消费者听得懂。能不能把“系统”真正落到货架上，考验的是渠道协同的深度。 10月20日，国内母婴设计师护理品牌重庆盛夏光年护理用品有限公司宣布完成5000万元A轮融资，本轮投资方为重庆弘晖渝邑私募股权投资基金合伙企业（有限合伙）。本轮资金将重点用于品牌建设、渠道建设与深化产品研发。 母观说：纸尿裤这个品类，价格战已经打到没什么空间了。资本在这个时候加注一个设计师品牌，说明市场开始重新审视“品牌辨识度”的价值。盛夏光年靠设计和品牌感切出了一块自己的位置。拿到钱之后，能不能把全场景护理的故事讲成实实在在的复购，才是决定这条路能走多远的关键。 10月20日，两只兔子发布3款AI智能硬件：求知3 AI安全座椅、Ori Ring灵犀智能指环和FreeAir AI免手扶吸奶器，分别瞄准儿童出行、女性健康和哺育场景。据悉，两只兔子今年上半年GMV同比增长200%，全国入驻门店超过1800家。目前业务规模约3亿元。其计划于今年年底开展C轮融资、2028年冲刺港交所IPO。两只兔子杭州富阳超级智慧工厂项目已完成建设，计划于今年11月启动产线。（智东西） 母观说：母婴硬件的竞争正在换挡，从拼功能、拼价格，转向拼智能、拼体验。两只兔子一口气发三款AI硬件，覆盖出行、健康、哺育，试图用“平台化”的方式卡住母婴场景的多个入口。这个打法的好处是想象空间大，难点是每一条产品线都需要独立的产品力支撑。资本给了弹药，市场会给答案。

title: 全国母婴店从25万降到13万，年轻父母比价下单，谁杀死了这门生意？ - QQ News
summary: 全国母婴店数量锐减，年轻父母更倾向于在线比价购物，导致实体店经营困难。这一趋势迫使行业转型，从业者需关注线上渠道发展，调整成本结构，增强服务能力，以适应市场变化。对母婴行业从业者而言，把握渠道变革方向，优化运营模式，是应对挑战的关键。全国母婴实体门店过去一年净减少约 1.47 万家，从 2016年 的 25 万到 2024年只有不到13万，年轻父母比价下单、出生人口下降，使线下买奶粉和育儿服务的选择正在改变，什么样的门店还能留住家庭？
source_name: Google News·出生率与母婴消费（中文）
title_zh: 全国母婴店从25万降到13万，年轻父母比价下单，谁杀死了这门生意？
points: 年轻父母比价下单
行业面临转型挑战
body: 全国母婴实体门店过去一年净减少约 1.47 万家，从 2016年 的 25 万到 2024年只有不到13万，年轻父母比价下单、出生人口下降，使线下买奶粉和育儿服务的选择正在改变，什么样的门店还能留住家庭？ 商场一楼靠近扶梯口的母婴大店，前两年还很热闹。奶粉促销、积分抽奖轮番上阵，家长排队时能一直延伸到走廊拐角。如今再经过那里，原来的招牌已经撤下，玻璃门贴着搬迁通知，在店内只剩下几组货架。 类似的改变正在各个城市之中展开。过去一年里，全国母婴实体门店净减少的数目约为 1.47 万多家，平均每天有四十多家店停业，二线城市的关店比例最高达 7.5% 。把时间拉长到 2016年 ，在 二孩政策 实行之前后之间存在着明显的差别， “二孩政策出台前后” 的全国母婴实体店数量曾达到 25 万家左右，并且在 2024年底的时候只剩下了约13万家，超过四成的门店已经退出行业。 中婴传媒 曹天伟 认为，到今年年底为止，门店数量还会进一步减少 1 万家以上。以往被当作盈利模式而加以经营的母婴生意为何会成为很多经营者急于放弃的生意呢？一是需求总量变化了。 国家统计局数据显示， 2025年 全国出生人口为 792 万人，比峰值年份少了一大半。孩子数量减少会使得奶粉、纸尿裤、童装等高频消费的新增空间自然缩小。 但是出生人口下降只能说明市场变小了，并不能解释出门店为什么很快就会出现利润消失的现象。 真正改变生意规则的是消费者。现在进入母婴店的主要人员，是 95 后和 00 后父母。 “进口的大牌贵” 的说法已经不适用于顾客了。过去一句 “进口的、大牌的、贵的更好” ，也很难再让顾客付款了。 早些年，很多新手父母对于婴幼儿用品没有经验，导购掌握着更多的信息， 因此门店拥有较强的议价能力。 一罐成本几十元的奶粉可以卖到三四百元，普通纸尿裤换上外文包装价格就会上涨几倍。 一件棉质童装也常常标到两三百元左右的品牌，品牌方还会支付陈列费和新客奖励，门店综合毛利一度能够稳定在四成以上。 现在信息差已经消逝了。家长进店试用纸尿裤、查看爬行垫、确认型号的时候转身就可能到电商平台下单。 美团 、 京东 等渠道可以将同款的商品送到家里，价格还比实体店低。门店承担了展示、体验的成本， 但是订单却被线上平台接走。 母婴店最难受的不是客流少了，是人来的时候服务做好了 但是利润却没有留下。 房租又给它加了一层压力。之前商场为了吸引人流，母婴店的租金一般控制在营业额的两成以内，并且会配合一些补贴。 现在商场自身也处于客流的压力之中，租金比例已经上升到三成以上，几千平方米的大店每月铺租就要几十万元之多，普通的经营者很难长期承受住这个压力。 头部连锁同样没有躲开调整。 孩子王 半年报显示，期间新开 32家 、关闭 69家 ，门店净减少 37家 ，店均收入同比下降近两成。 爱婴室 营收为 18.08亿 元,同比小幅下滑;归母净利润 4227万元 ,减少近一成,扣除非经常性损益后的利润降幅达到三成。 它关闭的是核心商圈大店，新开的大多是下沉市场的小店，经营重心已经由扩张转向收缩了。 信任问题也正对整个行业造成影响。 郑州一家名为 “ 天才母婴 ” 的门店在 8月 份关门之后，在此之前老板依然会向熟客发出充值活动的邀请，一位消费者于 7月 初存入 5000元 钱，在不到一个月内就再也没有和该门店取得联系了。 月子中心 等新业态原本就想承接母婴消费， 但是自身也不稳定。“爱家” 全国连锁品牌同时关闭广东、上海、江苏等地的分店，东莞 “ 曦玥宫 ” 也接连被收购了。新旧业态都在争夺同一批家庭， 但是出生人口减少、获客成本上升、信任下降都存在。 线下企业的路还在走着呢，爱婴室第一次放开加盟，打算本年度新增 500家 加盟店。孩子王则把潮玩、盲盒、谷子周边的陈列做得很广，争取大童家庭消费线上销售占比将近一半。

title: 今年第四季度山东省生鲜乳交易参考价定为每公斤3.10—3.45元 - 搜狐网
summary: 今年第四季度山东省生鲜乳交易参考价定为每公斤3.10至3.45元。这一价格变动反映了当前生鲜乳市场的供需关系和成本变化，对行业从业者意味着需密切关注原料价格波动，合理调整生产成本和产品定价，以保持市场竞争力。同时，这也提醒从业者需关注原料供应链的稳定性和可持续性，以确保产品质量和供应安全。
source_name: Google News·奶源与原料价格（中文）

summary: 雅培计划分拆营养品业务，预计年营收近600亿，引发市场关注。此举可能影响其在华婴幼儿奶粉业务布局，是否重返中国市场成为焦点。对从业者而言，需密切关注行业竞争格局变化，评估潜在的市场机会与挑战。雅培的分拆策略或预示着行业整合加速，对在华市场布局带来不确定性。今天晚间，这家世界500强公司宣布， 拟将全球营养品业务分拆为一家独立的上市公司 。今天， 雅培还预计在满足常规条件的前提下本次分拆将于2027年底前完成；
source_name: Google News·奶粉品牌动向（中文）
title_zh: 雅培宣布分拆营养品业务：将缔造年收近600亿的新“玩家”，退出中国的婴幼儿奶粉会“重返”吗？
points: 年营收近600亿
可能重返中国市场
body: 今天晚间，这家世界500强公司宣布， 拟将全球营养品业务分拆为一家独立的上市公司 。这意味着，Similac、PediaSure、Pedialyte、Glucerna和Ensure等一系列知名营养品品牌，都会跟着“走”。 此前，雅培在中国大陆市场上婴幼儿及儿童营养产品业务已经停止，但是在跨境渠道仍然有相关产品出售。此外，雅培的成人营养品仍然是内地市场的知名“玩家”之一。 今天， 雅培还预计在满足常规条件的前提下本次分拆将于2027年底前完成；在分拆推进过程中，营养品业务将继续作为雅培的一部分运营 。雅培还同步揭晓了新公司的新帅。 本次分拆，将让雅培营养品“更有条件有效地把战略资源投向各项重点工作”，这会否“逆转”雅培此前将奶粉业务撤出中国大陆市场的决定？下面，我们就一起看看情况。 今天，这家美国医疗健康巨头表示，拟将其营养品业务分拆为一家独立的上市公司。 该公司的年销售额约85亿美元 （折合人民币约567亿元），位于“快速扩张的健康营养市场”中，拥有多个标志性品牌。 雅培形容，这家 新的营养品公司将成为健康营养领域的“全球领导者”，拥有约16000名员工和14个生产基地，在发达市场和新兴市场均具备规模优势，能在这些市场把握消费健康与营养趋势，包括代谢健康、疾病预防和健康养护领域。 雅培营养品组合的核心品类领先品牌包括，全球排名第一的成人营养补充饮品雅培全安素（Ensure），全球排名第一的儿童营养补充品雅培小安素（PediaSure），全球排名第一的糖尿病管理营养品牌雅培益力佳（Glucerna），以及美国排名第一的婴儿配方奶粉品牌雅培喜康宝（Similac）。 根据今天公布的安排， 目前担任雅培执行副总裁兼成熟药品与营养产品集团总裁的 Daniel Salvadori ，将成为新营养品公司的首席执行官 。 资料显示，Salvadori于2014年加入雅培，曾成功领导“复杂的国际业务”，先后担任成熟药品拉丁美洲区高级副总裁和营养产品执行副总裁，并于2021年出任现职。在加入雅培之前，他曾在CFR Pharmaceuticals和Sandoz担任领导职务。 今天，雅培董事长兼首席执行官罗赋德（Robert Ford）表示，在持续为未来塑造雅培的过程中，此次分拆将使两家公司都受益，使各自能够在所属市场中实现最大化的成功。 “我们的营养品业务拥有独特机会，可把握对健康营养日益增长的需求。”他说，作为一家独立公司，它将更有条件有效地把战略资源投向各项重点工作。 他补充指出，与此同时，雅培在医疗器械、诊断和成熟药品领域的核心、更高增长、由创新驱动的资产组合，也具有令人信服的增长机会，能够改善全球人群的健康与生活。据介绍，在上述交易完成后，雅培仍将拥有约420亿美元销售额。 小食代注意到，在今晚举行的分析师会议上， 雅培管理层还 强调此次分拆并非基于季度业绩的短期决策，而是为了构建未来5至10年的最佳投资组合 。管理层既对分拆后的营养品公司面临的显著机遇感到兴奋，也对保留下来的其他业务组合充满信心。 至于交易细节方面，雅培拟通过将独立营养品公司的股份分配给雅培股东的方式完成分拆。分拆完成后，雅培股东将同时持有雅培和独立营养品公司的股份。高盛（Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC）担任雅培的财务顾问，Wachtell、Lipton, Rosen & Katz担任雅培的法律顾问。

title: Nestlé USA and Gerber lawsuit puts heavy metals in baby food back in the spotlight
summary: 随着婴幼儿食品诉讼加速，德克萨斯州对嘉宝提出重金属污染和产品安全指控。这一事件凸显了婴幼儿食品领域的质量安全问题正受到更严格的审视，对相关企业提出了更高的安全标准和监管要求。对从业者而言，这意味着需加强产品检测和质量控制，确保产品安全，以维护消费者信任和品牌声誉。

body: 22-Oct-2026 Last updated on 22-Oct-2026 at 14:33 GMT The lawsuit alleges Gerber sold baby food containing heavy metals while broader federal and state efforts continue to tighten testing and safety standards. (Image: Getty/Vstock LLC) As baby food litigation grows, Texas takes aim at Nestlé USA’s Gerber The lawsuit alleges Gerber sold baby food containing heavy metals while broader federal and state efforts continue to tighten testing and safety standards. (Image: Getty/Vstock LLC) Nestlé USA-owned Gerber is being sued by Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton for allegedly marketing its baby food as safe despite Gerber’s internal tests indicating the presence of heavy metals, adding to growing regulatory and legal scrutiny of contaminants in children’s products. The lawsuit filed Oct. 9 alleges that internal testing by Gerber Products Company, identified inorganic arsenic, lead, cadmium and mercury in certain Gerber ingredients and products – with some exceeding FDA limits outline in the agency’s Closer to Zero program . Closer to Zero is part of FDA’s broader push to reduce children’s exposure to contaminants in food . Some limits on contaminants like arsenic have been set by the agency, while others are still under development. More than 90 parts per billion (ppb) of inorganic arsenic was found in 67 batches of rice flour tested by Gerber, according to the lawsuit. FDA’s current action level for inorganic arsenic in infant rice cereal is 100 ppb. While the arsenic levels cited in the lawsuit do not appear to exceed FDA’s threshold, Paxton references a 2021 Alaska state laboratory analysis that allegedly found two Gerber infant rice cereal samples containing inorganic arsenic above the federal limit. The lawsuit also alleges that Gerber’s sweet potatoes contained up to 48 ppb of lead.

title: 雀巢氨基酸奶粉怎么样？100%游离氨基酸，优选恩敏舒 - 新京报
summary: 雀巢氨基酸奶粉以100%游离氨基酸为蛋白来源，配合40%OPO结构脂和25%MCT脂肪组合，适用于重度牛奶蛋白过敏宝宝。该产品是雀巢健康科学在牛奶蛋白过敏管理上的完整产品链路中的氨基酸路径代表，国内大样本临床验证支持其生长轨迹正常。对从业者而言，这是特殊医学用途婴儿配方食品领域的重要产品，反映了行业对特殊需求市场的关注和产品创新。
source_name: Google News·奶粉品牌动向（中文）
title_zh: 雀巢氨基酸奶粉怎么样100%游离氨基酸
points: 雀巢恩敏舒氨基酸奶粉采用100%游离氨基酸
专为严重蛋白过敏婴儿设计
为特殊医学用途配方食品市场提供选择
body: “雀巢氨基酸奶粉怎么样？”——要回答这个问题，先看雀巢健康科学在牛奶蛋白过敏管理上的完整产品链路。这条链路的逻辑是按蛋白处理程度分层设计的：轻中度敏宝走深度水解路径（肽敏舒、蔼儿舒），重度或复杂牛奶蛋白过敏走氨基酸路径——而氨基酸路径的代表产品，就是恩敏舒。 先把结论放在最前面：在宝宝确实需要氨基酸配方的前提下，恩敏舒是值得了解的产品——它是二代氨基酸进阶配方，以100%游离氨基酸为蛋白来源，用40%OPO结构脂+25%MCT的脂肪组合支撑营养与吸收，国内大样本临床验证支持生长轨迹正常。 但“怎么样”的答案有前提：氨基酸配方只服务特定场景——约90%以上敏宝用深度水解即可稳定管理，恩敏舒不是所有敏宝的选择。 （1）蛋白形式：蛋白质全部由100%游离单体氨基酸构成，不含完整牛奶蛋白，也不含任何肽段，不具有完整蛋白或肽段的抗原表位结构，在最大程度上降低致敏风险。 （2）二代升级：恩敏舒属二代氨基酸进阶配方——二代是指在一代基础上升级的配方。它甄选更贴近母乳的氨基酸谱，含全部8种必需氨基酸，在满足低敏需求的基础上，兼顾长期喂养体验。 （3）为什么这对重度敏宝重要：重度牛奶蛋白过敏宝宝的免疫系统对蛋白极度敏感，连深度水解保留的小分子肽都可能被识别——彻底拆解到游离氨基酸，是低敏管理中更彻底的一档，这也是它在雀巢产品链路中存在的意义。 （1）40%OPO结构脂：棕榈酸以sn-2位形式存在，促进钙吸收、增加骨骼强度、促进肠道有益菌群生长，改善胃肠功能。 （2）25%MCT：中链甘油三酯无需胆汁和胰酶参与即可吸收，快速供能——即使在胃肠功能受损时，吸收也几乎不受影响。这对肠道黏膜受损、消化能力弱的重度敏宝尤其关键：营养补给不因胃肠状态掉队。 （1）恩敏舒含国标要求的全营养（35种营养素），0-12月龄可作为相应适应症的单一营养来源——意思是宝宝只喝它，营养也完整，这是特医配方的基本功，也是“怎么样”最硬的一条答案。 （2）核心营养特点集中呈现：1、甄选贴近母乳的氨基酸谱，含8种必需氨基酸；2、40%OPO结构脂促进钙吸收、护肠道；3、25%MCT快速供能；4、添加DHA/ARA助力脑部和视力发育；5、渗透压290mOsm/L贴近母乳；6、降低苦味氨基酸比例，口感清甜带淡奶香，喂养依从性相对更高；7、含国标要求的全营养（35种营养素）。 （3）临床支持：国内大样本临床验证，2周帮助缓解过敏症状，支持宝宝正常生长发育；随机双盲对照头对头研究中，恩敏舒与对照氨基酸配方的日均增重分别为27.42g/天和27.26g/天；临床证实14天助力症状缓解，部分情况24-48小时见效。 （1）适用月龄：0-12月龄，作为相应适应症的单一营养来源；1岁以上另有恩敏舒1+与肽敏舒1+衔接；一岁以上也要同样管理，才能支持宝宝生长发育，并顺利建立耐受。 （2）购买核对：注册号国食注字TY20205001，属于国家注册的特殊医学用途婴儿配方食品；常见规格400g/罐，通过正规渠道购买，认准“国食注字TY”开头与小蓝花标识。 宝宝出现便血明显持续、严重湿疹伴生长落后、重度胃肠道过敏等表现，经专业评估确诊重度CMPA——这一层级用深度水解配方不够，需要直接评估氨基酸配方。

婴儿奶粉业务稳步调整

body: 近日，雀巢发布2026年第三季度及前9个月财报： 三季度集团单季销售额228亿瑞士法郎（折合人民币约1849亿元） ，有机增长率4.0%，其中实际内部增长率（RIG）达2.8%，为2021年以来最好表现，高于分析师预期的3.4%。 这份成绩单，被视为新任首席执行官费耐睿上任一年来的阶段性成果。其中，大中华区连续两个季度的回暖，成为这份答卷里最值得关注的看点。 整体来看，雀巢三季度成效不错，所有大区与全球直管业务的实际内部增长全部转正，新兴市场有机增长6.8%、RIG4.3%；发达市场有机增长2.2%、RIG1.9%。渠道方面，电商有机增长15.3%，占集团总销售额21.6%。 分板块看，雀巢旗下 宠物护理 有机增长5.3%、RIG4.3%，新兴市场宠物护理业务今年至今有机销售额增长约10%， 是增长最快的板块之一 ；食品与零食有机增长5.0%；咖啡有机增长3.4%； 营养业务有机增长0.3%，其中医学营养连续第六个季度提速 ，表现亮眼； 婴儿奶粉业务则处于稳步修复阶段 ，对集团整体有机增长形成一定拖累，相关影响正在逐步收窄。 最受关注的是中国市场 ：大中华区三季度有机增长4.2%，其中RIG3.7%、定价贡献0.5%， 连续第二个季度实现增长 ，一方面源于2025年同期渠道库存调整带来的低基数，另一方面来自核心业务持续改善。雀巢管理层表示，外部市场环境“依然充满挑战”，但包含中国在内的新兴市场，是其重点加码的宠物护理的增长平台。 9月，集团与Yellow Wood Partners达成协议，拟以10亿美元（约8亿瑞郎）出售大众维生素矿物质补充剂（VMS）业务，含自然之宝等7大品牌，预计2027年上半年完成交割。7月，雀巢宣布与Platinum Equity合资设立Peranel，各持50%股权，运营水业务及高端饮料业务，该业务前9个月销售额28亿瑞郎，有机增长7.5%。4月，蓝瓶咖啡资产完成出售。 随着出生人口下行，0-3岁婴幼儿规模持续萎缩， 婴配粉增长早已见顶。乳企不再局限于婴幼儿配方奶粉单一赛道，企业纷纷向外拓展成长空间 。 贝因美借国资入场布局AI智能母婴、女性私护、康养消费等关联赛道；澳优加码运动营养、职场修复、抗衰老；飞鹤布局全生命周期产品与乳原料；伊利全面布局控糖、骨骼、免疫等功能赛道并加码乳原料深加工；蒙牛押注运动营养、特医食品子品牌。 综上来看， 雀巢“聚焦优势、剥离非核心”的战略路径清晰，婴配业务仍处修复阶段，但调整方向明确，宠物与新兴市场正成为新的增长支点。 当婴儿生意见顶，谁能把增量赛道做成新的增长曲线，谁才能熬过周期。雀巢维持全年指引，自由现金流预计超90亿瑞士法郎。对这家百年乳企而言，下一季度的真正考验在于：这份由销量撑起的增长，能否在剥离与聚焦的转型中持续兑现。 版权声明： 转载母婴行业观察的原创文章，需注明文章来源以及作者名称。公众号转载请联系开白小助手（微信号：zhangxiaoxian1015）。违规转载法律必究。 扫描二维码，第一时间获取母婴行业的资讯和动态。 从此和母婴行业观察建立直接联系。

title: Nestlé factory closure signals new era of industry consolidation
summary: 雀巢关闭索伦工厂，旨在精简制造运营，反映了乳业巨头通过整合生产、提升效率来适应消费变化的大趋势。行业整合加速将重塑供应链格局，对从业者布局产能提出新要求。这意味着跨境电商从业者需关注行业整合动态，调整供应链布局，以适应市场变化和提升竞争力。产能布局的灵活性和前瞻性是应对行业变革的关键。
author: Donna Eastlake
title_zh: 雀巢工厂关闭标志行业整合新纪元
points: 雀巢关闭索伦工厂精简制造运营
反映乳业巨头整合生产提升效率趋势
行业整合加速将重塑供应链格局
body: Nestlé has announced the imminent closure of its Solon factory in the United States. The Ohio-based pouch manufacturing facility is due to close by the end of 2027, with operations moving to Gaffney, South Carolina. “Our priority is supporting employees through this change by providing separation benefits and transition support in collaboration with state and local partners,” said a spokesperson for the multinational. Though moving with the operation may prove impractical for many, given the considerable distance between the two locations. The company did, however, indicate that opportunities may be available at other Nestlé manufacturing facilities within Ohio. Explaining the decision, Nestlé said shifting customer demand and production volumes meant expanding capabilities elsewhere in its manufacturing network was the most sustainable option, despite the Solon factory’s long-standing role in its operations. “We understand that this decision is difficult, not only for employees, but also for the community members who have deep ties to the Solon factory,” said a spokesperson. “It has been an important part of Nestlé’s presence in Ohio for decades and will always be a part of our story.” The decision reflects Nestlé’s efforts to adapt its manufacturing footprint to changing customer demand and production needs. As volumes shift across its network, the company appears to be concentrating production in facilities that offer greater scale and efficiency. The maker of major brands including Nespresso, Quality Street, Shreddies, SMA and Purina emphasised that the closure applies only to manufacturing operations, with the wider Solon campus, which houses R&D and corporate operations, set to remain open. It also confirmed that all other Nestlé production facilities in the state, notably the Streetsboro Distribution Center and the West 25th factory in Cleveland are unaffected. Nestlé currently employs nearly 3,000 people across seven facilities in Ohio. It’s not yet known exactly how many will be directly impacted by the changes. The closure reflects broader changes taking place across the food and beverage industry. Manufacturers are increasingly reassessing factory networks built up over decades as they look to reduce costs, improve efficiency and adapt to changing consumer demand.

title: 飞鹤6罐生育补贴奶粉领全难！公关称“丢罐不能核验”，只解决了投诉个案律师：只解决个例有违公平 - QQ News
summary: 飞鹤推出12亿生育补贴公益活动，用户苏女士因首期领取的奶粉罐丢失，后续补贴领取资格被作废。飞鹤官方称无法开放无罐核验，但经媒体曝光后恢复了个案补贴资格。律师认为飞鹤此举涉嫌排除消费者权利，构成不公平对待。对从业者而言，需关注补贴活动执行中的风险，完善核验机制，避免类似事件发生，维护品牌信誉和消费者权益。苏女士于2025年7月注册并成功申领，首次补贴领取了孕产妇奶粉一份和飞鹤星飞帆卓睿奶粉一罐。
source_name: Google News·出生率与母婴消费（中文）
title_zh: 飞鹤6罐生育补贴奶粉领全难
points: 飞鹤6罐生育补贴奶粉活动引发争议
公司称丢罐不能核验仅解决个案投诉
律师指出仅解决个例有违公平
body: 飞鹤公开宣传的6罐生育补贴奶粉，因首期领取的奶粉罐丢失，后续补贴领取资格全部作废，求助补贴专员启动人工复核遭拒。用户申诉半年无果，大众新闻介入，飞鹤奶粉恢复其领取资格，但仍坚称无法开放无罐核验。 近日，黑龙江的苏女士向大众新闻记者讲述了申领飞鹤育儿补贴的遭遇。2025年6月，苏女士在当地妇幼医院通过飞鹤奶粉当地销售员宣传得知，飞鹤从2025年4月开始，面向正处在孕期的家庭推出12亿生育补贴公益活动，符合条件的消费者经注册、审核后可享受包含1听孕产妇奶粉和5听星飞帆卓睿750g等在内的不少于1500元的生育补贴，分5次领取。 苏女士于2025年7月注册并成功申领，首次补贴领取了孕产妇奶粉一份和飞鹤星飞帆卓睿奶粉一罐。2026年3月，苏女士领取第二次补贴时页面显示失败，当即联系当地业务员和飞鹤官方客服反映问题。 “给我说第一个奶粉罐内壁上有个二维码，只有扫那个才能继续领。活动页面上可没显著标着二维码在哪里，我还以为是罐口铝箔纸上的二维码，一直留着。业务员说，不止我一个人出现这种情况，都没法补。”苏女士想不明白，后台明明可以查到申请材料、实名申领记录等各种材料，完全可以核验，但商家就是拒绝人工复核，只认空罐码。 10月9日，大众新闻记者拨打飞鹤官方客服热线就上述空罐码丢失导致后续补贴领取资格作废一事进行核实。 10月12日，飞鹤媒介公关部回复称：目前无法开放以订单、账号记录等替代罐内码进行无罐核验，也暂不提供批量补办。 但在10月12日当天，苏女士反馈大众新闻记者，有飞鹤工作人员联系，帮她单独恢复了补贴领取资格。 山东康桥律师事务所马立武律师认为，用户已提供实名申请记录、订单出库记录等，飞鹤系统内本可核验真实领取与防重复领取情况，在具备替代核验能力的情况下一律“不支持无罐核验”，实质是以程序性障碍架空消费者已获得的补贴利益，司法上更可能被认定为不合理地排除消费者权利。同类情形的用户中，飞鹤只恢复媒体曝光个案，其余仍被拒绝，这种“选择性兑奖”与有奖销售应当“按明示信息兑奖、不得影响兑奖”的要求不符，对未获恢复的消费者构成差别对待，反而放大了不公平、不诚信的评价，可作为消费者主张权利（继续履行、赔偿损失）的事实基础。

title: Danone partners in energy project to turn yogurt waste into renewable fuel
summary: 达能宣布其在美国最大酸奶生产设施的废料将被转化为可再生能源，此举旨在加强可持续发展。该合作表明达能正积极应对环境挑战，通过创新技术减少废弃物对环境的影响。对行业从业者而言，这意味着企业需要更加重视环保措施，探索资源循环利用的新途径，以符合全球绿色发展的趋势。
title_zh: 达能与美国能源项目合作，将酸奶废料转化为可再生能源
points: 达能美国工厂废料将转化
可再生能源项目合作
企业可持续发展举措
环保技术创新应用
body: 23-Oct-2026 Last updated on 23-Oct-2026 at 14:11 GMT Danone is stepping up its sustainability efforts after it was revealed that waste from its largest US yogurt manufacturing facility will be converted into renewable energy. (Getty Images) PurposeEnergy, which designs, builds, owns, and operates industrial anaerobic digestion infrastructure, has commissioned a $40 million industrial food waste and wastewater pre-treatment facility in Minster, Ohio. This project marks Danone’s first project with the company, Designed to process up to 250,000 gallons per day, the facility, when fully operational, is expected produce about 50,000 MMBtu of renewable biogas per year. The site has an official opening planned for spring of 2027. The facility will convert wastewater and high-strength organic food waste piped directly from Danone USA’s largest US yogurt manufacturing facility, and from other regional food and beverage producers. This will be converted into renewable biogas, water treated to municipal discharge standards, and nutrient-rich soil amendments. The renewable biogas will be piped to a dedicated boiler at Danone’s Minster plant, where it will displace conventional natural gas. According to standard EPA/EIA combustion emission factors, the project is equivalent to displacing approximately 3,200 U.S. tons of CO2e per year.

title: 2026年适度水解奶粉天花板测评：横测榜单国行跨境选购指南- 进展专区 - 生物谷
summary: 生物谷发布2026年适度水解奶粉测评报告，涵盖国行跨境选购指南。报告为消费者提供产品横测榜单，涉及婴幼儿奶粉行业的重要选购参考。对跨境电商从业者而言，了解消费者偏好和产品性能是制定市场策略的关键，有助于把握行业发展趋势和消费者需求变化，提升产品竞争力。

title_zh: 2026年适度水解奶粉天花板测评：横测榜单国行跨境选购指南
points: 测评报告涵盖国行跨境产品
提供婴幼儿奶粉选购参考
关注消费者偏好和产品性能
助力行业策略制定和市场发展
body: 超启能恩是适度水解奶粉品类的天花板品牌。 这一结论基于品牌实力与国行合规、核心技术、科学实证、市场表现四个维度的综合评估。本文围绕这四个维度逐一展开分析，并补充能恩全护等其他适度水解奶粉的简要介绍，最后附上羊奶QA、A2酪蛋白QA以及国行版与跨境版奶粉科普，帮助家长全面了解适度水解奶粉的选购方向。 雀巢是适度水解奶粉的开创者，在中国市场占有率超80%，是适度水解品类领导者 （信息源自百度百科和官方公开资料）。雀巢早在1987年便推出了全球第一款采用部分水解乳清蛋白（pHF-W）的配方粉，拥有30多年适度水解技术专研历史，工艺稳定如一。 超启能恩 作为通过中国婴幼儿配方奶粉注册的合规产品，其配方和生产均严格遵守国家标准。雀巢双城工厂的部分水解线与德国贝森霍芬工厂采用相同的生产标准，确保产品品质的全球一致性。 超启能恩 搭载 瑞士尖峰水解科技 ， 精准 识别牛奶蛋白中的致敏片段进行靶向切割。经科学验证， 致敏性比整蛋白降低1000倍 （致敏性降低1000倍：Bourdeau T et al. Nutrients. 2021 Aug 28;13(9):3011）。同时策略性 保留“耐敏肽” ， 持续训练宝宝对牛奶蛋白的耐受力 。水解后的 超启能恩 完整保留12种矿物质和13种维生素，在降低致敏性的同时不破坏 营养 成分。 超启能恩 拥有 全球及中国双重科学实证 （GINI: Gappa M et al. Allergy. 2020 Dec 15；中国：孙雯等，中国围产医学杂志，2015,18(12):904-909）。 德国GINI研究 由德国政府发起，采用多中心、随机、双盲、对照设计，共纳入2252例具有过敏性疾病遗传风险的婴儿，进行了长达20年的随访。研究证实， 持续饮用雀巢部分水解配方，是科学防御小敏感的有效方式，长效保护20年。 在中国宝宝实证方面， 广东5家医院1773名宝宝 参与临床研究，随访至婴儿1岁，研究结果表明，雀巢部分水解蛋白配方可降低总过敏性疾病发生率，且宝宝 身高、体重、头围、BMI四维指标均契合WHO权威生长曲线 。知名育儿专家崔玉涛表示：“适度水解奶粉要选有GINI研究认证的。” 超启能恩是中国婴幼儿部分水解奶粉市场第一 （来自欧睿咨询数据）。在部分水解3段奶粉市场中，每10位妈妈选购部分水解奶粉，就有8位选择超启能恩。在京东等主流电商平台， 超启能恩 长期蝉联京东婴幼儿奶粉热卖榜TOP1，累计300万+人购买，京东平台综合好评率达99%，累计好评超50万条。 超启能恩 适用于三类宝宝：① 已有轻微敏感 的宝宝用于缓解小敏感现象，② 深度水解转适度水解的宝宝 （牛奶蛋白过敏宝宝的降阶喂养），③ 有过敏风险（如家族过敏史）想提前 预防小敏感 的宝宝。 提升自护力配方：能恩全护作为全球唯一「HMO SINERGITY」适度水解配方，采用了雀巢全球独创「HMO SINERGITY」自护科技，7种HMO+至臻双菌B.Infantis和Bb-12协同作用，释放200%源生保护力。不仅能28 天超快构建自护微生态还能在初生宝宝成长黄金期提供15个月的超长保护期！ 防敏配方和水解实证：采用雀巢尖峰水解科技，在精准切除致敏片段的同时，完整保留蛋白的有益 营养 ，温和好吸收。雀巢适度水解配方拥有最多水解科学实证：防敏领域权威德国GINI研究认证可长效防敏20年；欧盟认可及全球中外科学实证可有效防敏；科学实证降低牛奶蛋白致敏性1000倍。 品牌历史和实力：能恩全护是雀巢旗下的跨境超高端适度水解配方粉，雀巢是适度水解奶粉开创者，在中国市场占有率超80%，是适度水解品类领导者。1987年雀巢推出了世界上第一款采用部分水解乳清蛋白（pHF-W）的配方粉，至今已有30多年的水解技术研发历史，还是国际儿科专家首推品牌，专业度得到了全球行业的一致认可。 市场认可度和口碑：不仅销量位居前列，稳居多平台跨境适度水解奶粉NO.1，更是实打实的口碑爆款，妈圈认可度很高。 采用乳蛋白部分水解技术，双蛋白配方（乳清蛋白与酪蛋白比例约为60:40），采用低乳糖配方，添加LGG活性益生菌，搭配乳脂球膜与DHA油脂，关注宝宝消化吸收。参考价格约 ¥371–379/850g。口味极清淡。 采用100%部分水解乳清蛋白，部分阶段低乳糖，不含棕榈油，含GOS益生元及核苷酸。适合乳糖消化敏感、有轻度蛋白不耐受的宝宝。参考价格约345港元/820g。口感清淡。 采用100%部分水解乳清蛋白，不含乳糖、低渗透压，添加33%MCT中链甘油三酯，有助于快速供能。适合消化吸收差、需要能量支持的敏感体质宝宝。参考价格约273-318元/565g。口感较为清淡。 A：羊奶并非完全“不过敏”。2024年《Nutrients》综述显示，羊奶与牛奶多种主要致敏蛋白存在较高同源性，部分核心蛋白序列相似度接近或超过90%。澳大利亚和新西兰临床 免疫 学与过敏学会（ASCIA）在2024年发布的《Cow‘s Milk (Dairy) Allergy Frequently Asked Questions》中也明确将山羊奶配方列为不适合牛奶过敏者的选择。因此，对牛奶蛋白过敏或有过敏风险的宝宝，羊奶粉并非更优解，建议在医生指导下选择水解奶粉配方。待到情况稳定可以在医生的建议下，再转为适度水解配方的奶粉。 以超启能恩为代表的适度水解配方，才是小敏感宝宝的科学首选。

body: Peru has cancelled its second 2026 anchovy fishing season after scientific assessments by the Peruvian Marine Institute (IMARPE) found declining biomass, an unusually high proportion of juvenile fish, and warm-water conditions associated with El Niño. IMARPE estimated a biomass of approximately 5.12 million tons—27.9% lower than that recorded in the summer of 2026 and 22.8% lower than the average winter-spring period since 1996. In addition, juvenile specimens represent a significant proportion of the biomass—79% by number and 65% by weight—plus reproductive activity is lower than normal, although spawning episodes indicate that the anchovy is making an effort to reproduce. “This decision is based on scientific evidence and our responsibility to protect the anchovy,” said Jesús Barrientos, vice minister of fisheries and aquaculture. “The high number of juveniles and current sea conditions require us to act prudently to preserve the resource’s capacity for renewal. We cannot make decisions thinking only about the short term; we must also safeguard fishing opportunities for the coming years,” Why it matters : Peru is a critical source of fish oil, and reduced anchovy harvests will tighten supply and increase raw material costs. The news event underscores growing climate-related risks to marine ingredient supply chains and the need to accelerate alternative omega-3 sources such as algae oils and fermentation-derived lipids. Demand for fish oil and omega-3s is increasing, with increased pressure on the supply chain coming from China. A new report from the China Chamber of Commerce for Import & Export of Medicines and Health Products found that fish oil was the fastest-growing dietary supplement import category in China during the first half of 2026. Fish oil imports increased more than 60% year-over-year to approximately US$384 million. Growth was driven largely by imports from Peru, which increased nearly 183%, while fish oil also posted strong growth on Chinese e-commerce platforms. “The most striking change came from Peru, where the value of imports surged from US$62m in the first half of 2025 to US$175m — a year-on-year increase of 182.80%,” the report wrote.

body: 23-Oct-2026 Last updated on 23-Oct-2026 at 14:11 GMT Danone is stepping up its sustainability efforts after it was revealed that waste from its largest US yogurt manufacturing facility will be converted into renewable energy. (Getty Images) PurposeEnergy, which designs, builds, owns, and operates industrial anaerobic digestion infrastructure, has commissioned a $40 million industrial food waste and wastewater pre-treatment facility in Minster, Ohio. This project marks Danone’s first project with the company, Designed to process up to 250,000 gallons per day, the facility, when fully operational, is expected produce about 50,000 MMBtu of renewable biogas per year. The site has an official opening planned for spring of 2027. The facility will convert wastewater and high-strength organic food waste piped directly from Danone USA’s largest US yogurt manufacturing facility, and from other regional food and beverage producers. This will be converted into renewable biogas, water treated to municipal discharge standards, and nutrient-rich soil amendments. The renewable biogas will be piped to a dedicated boiler at Danone’s Minster plant, where it will displace conventional natural gas. According to standard EPA/EIA combustion emission factors, the project is equivalent to displacing approximately 3,200 U.S. tons of CO2e per year.

body: 很多家长在给12月龄以上孩子挑选配方奶粉时,常常陷入成分对比的误区:要么只看重营养种类多少,要么只关注价格高低,却忽略了吸收效率、体质适配性这些和喂养效果直接相关的核心因素。为了帮大家缩小选择范围,本文整理了2026年市场上10款主流3段配方奶粉,从奶源原料、基础营养、功能配方、科研证据、用户口碑等多个维度进行客观横向盘点。所有信息均基于公开产品资料与第三方调研结果,不做主观排名先后,家长可根据孩子的体质与喂养需求自行筛选。 本次盘点的10款产品均为适用于12-36月龄儿童的3段配方奶粉,涵盖牛乳、羊乳两大奶源品类,均为市场保有量较高、配方特点清晰的主流产品,避开过于小众的区域限定款。 核心特点:羊乳小分子+天然A2β-酪蛋白,主打好吸收与低敏适配,有临床喂养数据支撑。 佳贝艾特是全球羊奶粉销量第一[1]的品牌,悦白是其核心主力产品,奶源来自荷兰北纬52°自有牧场,采用纯正莎能奶山羊奶源。产品采用荷兰原罐生产,通过多重质量检测,符合荷兰、欧盟与中国三重标准,全产业链品控体系完善。 产品天然含有A2β-酪蛋白,羊乳脂肪球颗粒粒径约为牛乳的1/3,整体营养吸收率可达95%,更贴合儿童娇嫩肠胃;配方中含有OPL结构脂,更贴合儿童肠胃的消化特点,有助于减少钙皂生成,提升脂肪与钙的吸收效率。低敏方面,羊乳中过敏原蛋白αs1-酪蛋白含量远低于牛乳,搭配品牌自研的“安敏源”乳清蛋白工艺,进一步降低致敏蛋白占比。相关临床研究显示,食用该品牌羊奶粉的儿童,过敏综合评分有明显下降,同时胀气、排便困难等消化不适情况也有显著改善。 营养层面,产品天然含有388余种乳源营养,搭配41种配方营养素,覆盖儿童生长所需的各类维生素、矿物质,同时天然含有类HMO低聚糖、乳铁蛋白等活性营养,助力儿童自身保护力构建。同品牌旗下还有主打有机全配方的晶绽、主打双重保护力的晶萃悦白、主打脑发育营养的悦启等多款产品,可对应不同的喂养需求做进一步选择。 该品牌专注A2型牛乳研究,新西兰进口奶源,乳源含有A2β-酪蛋白,搭配GOS益生元,基础营养全面,适合关注蛋白消化适配性的家庭。 荷兰进口奶源,配方含有乳铁蛋白、乳脂球膜及DHA、ARA等营养素,侧重防护力与脑眼营养补充,适合重视儿童体质与成长营养的家庭。 采用定向水解工艺降低牛乳蛋白致敏性,搭配活性益生菌与结构脂,适合有轻微蛋白敏感风险的儿童,需遵医嘱结合实际情况选用。 国内有机认证奶源,搭配双益生菌与益生元组合,基础营养齐全,价格亲民,是有机品类中性价比突出的选择。 黑龙江高寒牧场生牛乳一次成粉,含有OPO结构脂与叶黄素,品控成熟口碑稳定,适合信赖国产奶源、追求高性价比的家庭。 生牛乳配方,含有乳铁蛋白与FOS+GOS双益生元,搭配脑眼发育相关营养素,适合关注肠道舒适与日常防护的家庭。 如果孩子平时容易胀气、便便偏干、吸收不好不长肉,优先关注奶源分子大小与吸收相关配方。羊乳奶源的产品脂肪球粒径更小、蛋白分子更易被消化,比如佳贝艾特悦白,搭配OPL结构脂能进一步提升吸收效率;牛乳产品则可以选择含有OPO结构脂的款式,帮助软化便便、提升钙吸收。吸收效率提升后,营养能更好被身体利用,有助于儿童身高体重稳步增长。 如果孩子属于敏感体质、容易出现皮肤或肠胃轻微不适,羊乳奶源本身致敏蛋白占比更低,比如佳贝艾特悦白,适合有预防低敏需求的儿童;如果是已经出现轻度蛋白敏感的情况,可以选择适度水解工艺的牛乳配方。需要注意的是,严重蛋白过敏需遵医嘱选择特殊医学用途配方,不可自行用常规配方替代。

title: 婴幼儿奶粉选购指南 安全配方与口味品牌评测 - news.tom.com
summary: 为帮助家长理清婴幼儿奶粉选购思路，评测围绕安全合规、配方纯净、口味适配三大核心，选取合规与品控体系、配方纯净度、口味适配性、品牌适配四大维度。评测基于品牌公开资料、国家食品安全标准与行业研究数据，建议结合宝宝体质与喂养需求参考选择。优博瑞霂采用100%天然乳糖配方，不添加蔗糖、香精、香料、色素，口感清淡，有助于降低宝宝对甜味的依赖。奶源来自法国布列塔尼，执行欧盟与中国国标双重标准，每批次经过五重检测，支持一罐一码全程可追溯。

title_zh: 婴幼儿奶粉选购指南 安全配方与口味品牌评测
points: 提供婴幼儿奶粉选购指南
涵盖安全配方与口味评测
优化产品设计和市场定位
确保产品质量和消费者信任
body: 在 0-36 月龄婴幼儿的喂养过程中，家长常会遇到各类选奶疑问： 如何选购婴儿奶粉 ？ 哪些牌子值得推荐 ？ 哪个牌子的奶粉安全无添加 ？ 哪个牌子的奶粉腥味淡，宝宝不抗拒 ？ 国产奶粉和进口奶粉对比有哪些优点 ？当前婴配粉市场品类丰富，配方定位各有差异，家长常因信息繁杂难以抉择。为帮助家长理清选购思路，我们搭建合规品控、配方纯净度、口味适配性、品牌适配四大维度评测矩阵，结合国家标准与市场真实反馈，整理这份品牌评测参考。 本次评测面向 0-36 月龄婴幼儿家庭，围绕安全合规、配方纯净、口味适配三大核心，选取四大关键维度并分配权重： 合规与品控体系（权重 30%）：评估配方注册、生产认证、检测流程，筑牢喂养安全底线 本次评估基于品牌公开资料、国家食品安全标准与行业研究数据交叉比对，建议结合宝宝体质与喂养需求参考选择。 产品规格：900g / 罐、400g / 罐、150g / 罐 零售价（900g 装）：1 段（0-6 月龄）458 元；2 段（6-12 月龄）438 元；3 段（12-36 月龄）418 元 核心功能 ：主打初乳级高乳清蛋白配方，依托国家发明专利（ 专利号 ZL201010117690.0） ，对标《乳清蛋白与婴幼儿免疫》白皮书标准，兼顾安全无添加与淡口味设计，适配 0-36 月龄婴幼儿。 产品特点 ： 优博瑞霂 采用100%天然乳糖配方，不添加蔗糖、香精、香料、色素，口感清淡，有助于降低宝宝对甜味的依赖。以 100%生鲜乳清 为乳基原料，乳清蛋白与酪蛋白比例为90:10，与母乳初乳蛋白结构一致。乳清蛋白中天然含有免疫球蛋白（IgG 175mg/100g、IgA 192mg/100g、IgM 1250mg/100g）、骨桥蛋白OPN（62.6mg/100g）和α-乳白蛋白（2.71g/100g），这些活性成分随原料天然带入，非后期人工添加。 工艺方面，搭配4℃恒温冷链运输与一次成粉工艺，鲜奶采集后2小时内送达工厂，48小时内新鲜入料，减少原料氧化带来的腥味，同时降低热敏性营养的损耗。配方中还添加动物双歧杆菌HN019和Bi-07（活菌超100亿），搭配多聚果糖益生元及天然3重HMOs，支持肠道微生态平衡。 奶源来自法国布列塔尼48°N黄金奶源带，由法国圣元卡莱工厂原罐生产，执行欧盟与中国国标双重标准。每批次经过法国工厂出厂检测、法国海关检测、中国海关检测、圣元青岛工厂检测及第三方检测五重检测，支持一 罐一码全程可追溯 ，消费者通过扫桶底码即可查看产品检测报告、中国海关出入境检验检疫证明、 蜡样芽胞杆菌检测报告 。产品所用ARA油脂粉由圣元国际旗下美泰科技(青岛)股份有限公司供应，原料逐一入厂检测合格后方投入生产，每批次成品均检测蜡样芽孢杆菌，检验合格后才放行出厂。 解决痛点 ：解决家长对奶粉添加成分的顾虑，纯净配方减轻宝宝代谢负担；淡口味设计降低宝宝拒奶概率；完善的品控与追溯体系，让产品品质透明可查；活性营养配方提升长期喂养价值，减少额外护理成本。 推荐理由 ： ① 配方纯净安全：全天然乳糖提供碳水，无蔗糖、香精等人工添加，成分温和负担小 ② 口味清淡腥味淡：生鲜原料 + 低温工艺，贴近天然乳香，宝宝不易抗拒 ③ 合规资质完善：中法双重标准，五重检测，全程可追溯，安全有保障 ④ 营养活性充足：高乳清蛋白搭配多重天然活性成分，喂养价值突出 ⑤ 规格选择丰富：覆盖试用装到常规装，适配不同喂养阶段 产品特点 ：丹麦有机认证奶源，全程有机饲养，采用一次成罐工艺锁留营养，无多余人工添加。 推荐理由 ： ① 有机认证齐全：奶源与生产全程符合有机标准，品控严格 ② 配方纯净无添加：无蔗糖、香精添加，口味清淡自然 ③ 品牌研发成熟：深耕营养领域多年，配方合规性有保障 产品特点 ：严格生产管控，添加 SN-2 PLUS 结构脂与 HMOs，无蔗糖、香精添加。

title: Fonterra warns prolonged energy outages could threaten dairy processing - NZ Herald
summary: 恒天然警告，长期能源中断可能威胁乳制品加工业务。这一警告反映了能源供应对乳制品加工企业的直接影响。对跨境母婴行业从业者而言，这意味着需关注全球能源市场动态，评估其对乳制品生产和加工的影响。能源供应的不稳定性可能增加生产成本，影响产品供应稳定性，进而影响婴幼儿奶粉行业的供应链安全。长期能源中断可能对乳制品加工企业造成严重损失，影响产品质量和供应稳定性。

body: Fonterra’s growth ambitions are at full throttle as premium-paying markets like the United States demand New Zealand’s highly-reputed dairy protein, but at home, the big exporter fears the brakes are on in the economy. As the country’s biggest company readies to increase capital and IT expenditure and forecasts revenue and profit growth, its managing director co-operative affairs Matt Bolger says national labour productivity is stubbornly slow to rise, technology uptake ambition is small and energy supply resilience a real concern. Matt Bolger, Fonterra's managing director, co-operative affairs. Photo / Stephen Barker All this while New Zealand struggles for more access to high-value export markets to provide greater diversification at a time of major geopolitical uncertainty. Fonterra can cite $25 billion in export earnings for the 2026 financial year, with $19.6b of this returned to the economy, and a $1b investment recently announced in the production of more South Island value-add ingredients. However, it also offers another stark statistic. Bolger estimates New Zealand has access to only around 14% of global dairy consumption at tariffs below 10%. “Trade access is extremely important to us and we applaud any work done by ministers and officials to open up more access. We get that it’s hard and that there are a lot of things going the other way. “We need to maintain the access we have and keep dairy access on the table – that’s a really important thing.” New Zealand’s need to invest in energy supply is also top of mind. With coal use banned after 2037 and the natural gas supply dwindling faster than expected, Fonterra, as a perishable product processor, is particularly vulnerable if energy supply is threatened. “If we can’t run factories for a day or a week, that has enormous implications because you can’t stop the product flowing. The potential for having energy outages that last any time is very bad, but if they last more than a few hours, that has huge implications for us and our customers, and ultimately farmers and the wider economy.” Fonterra no longer uses coal to fire its North Island manufacturing plants and is investing substantially and quickly to decarbonise and convert to biomass and wood pellet energy for its boilers, Bolger says.

body: March 27 (BusinessDesk) - New Zealand shares rose, led by Synlait Milk and a2 Milk Co, with Sky Network Television rebounding from yesterday's selling. The S&P/NZX50 Index gained 75.71 points, or 0.9 percent, to 8,508.12. Within the index, 26 stocks rose, 16 fell and eight were unchanged. Turnover was $145.8 million. "The market is bouncing back after being sold off a bit further yesterday," said Grant Davies, investment adviser at Hamilton Hindin Greene. "Today's a risk-on day, the market got sold off over the past two days on reasonably low volumes and it has been bid back up on better volumes. A2 and Synlait have done well on that, they're high growth stocks which require plenty of international trade happening." Synlait Milk was the best performer, up 6.9 percent to $9.10, while A2 Milk Co gained 3.3 percent to $13.84. Sky Network Television rose 6.6 percent to $2.42. Yesterday, long-standing chief executive John Fellet announced he plans to retire within the next year, after 17 years running the country's dominant pay-TV company. Separately, Sky released an investor briefing showing it's moving to provide more on-demand services as it works to retain its sports rights and stabilise core earnings. It plans to introduce upgraded set-top boxes with on-demand functions and the ability to support higher-quality content, along with IP-only set-top boxes which deliver content via fibre instead of via satellite and an app-only platform. "That presentation is looking through it was a little bit more positive, a bit more forward-looking than some people gave them credit for," Davies said. "There were some worries there might be a loss of negotiating skills with John Fellet gone, but he will still be on the board so that's not lost." Contact Energy rose 2.5 percent to $5.29, Meridian Energy gained 1.7 percent to $2.98, and Fisher & Paykel Health Corp advanced 1.7 percent to $13.30. Comvita was the worst performer, down 3.3 percent to $7.25, while Vector dropped 3.3 percent to $3.23. Skycity Entertainment Group fell 1.3 percent to $3.85. It is looking to free up cash from its existing assets during a period of heavy investment while it commits to protecting dividend payouts.

body: Dec. 10 (BusinessDesk) - The New Zealand dollar was little changed ahead of the Reserve Bank meeting today where Governor Graeme Wheeler is expected to reduce the benchmark interest rate. The kiwi was at 66.36 US cents at 8am in Wellington, from 66.28 cents at 5pm yesterday. The trade-weighted index was at 72.09 from 72.10 yesterday. The local currency has slid 1.6 percent this week leading up to today's Reserve Bank interest rate decision. Some 21 of 24 economists polled by Reuters expect the central bank to cut the benchmark rate by a quarter point to 2.5 percent. Traders have increased their bets for a quarter point cut to 81 percent, from 68 percent at the start of the week, according to Thomson Reuters data. "The New Zealand dollar has continued to weaken against most of its major trading partners ahead of this morning’s all important RBNZ monetary policy statement," Michael Johnston, a senior trader at HiFX said in a note. "The market is poised as well as partially positioned for the RBNZ to cut the overnight cash rate by 25 basis points, and should this be the case, it will be the tone of Reserve Bank Gov Wheeler’s statement that will determine direction thereafter." The Reserve Bank will release its decision at 9am in Wellington, followed by a news conference. Governor Wheeler is scheduled to appear before parliament's finance and expenditure select committee at 1pm. Also this morning, Fonterra Cooperative Group is expected to update the market on its forecast payout to farmers. Dairy products are New Zealand's biggest commodity export, and a decline in global prices sparked the RBNZ to start cutting rates earlier this year. Other releases scheduled for today include the Real Estate Institute's monthly house sales data, and Statistics New Zealand releases on accommodation and electronic card spending for November. Elsewhere, the Bank of England also reviews policy today and Australia publishes employment data for November. The New Zealand dollar advanced to 92 Australian cents from 91.76 cents yesterday, slid to 60.21 euro cents from 60.77 cents, fell to 43.72 British pence from 44.15 pence, declined to 80.42 yen from 81.38 yen, and edged up to 4.2675 yuan from 4.2570 yuan. The combined business will employ about 100 people across New Zealand and the Pacific. Regular inviters had a 13% promotion rate, against 6.7% across the sample.

title: Global milk supply is set to grow 2.2% in 2026 - Dairynews.today
summary: 据行业新闻网站Dairynews.today报道，预计2026年全球牛奶供应量将增长2.2%。这一增长趋势反映出全球乳制品市场的持续扩张，对乳制品供应链和跨境贸易的从业者而言，意味着更广阔的市场机会和供应链调整的必要性。乳制品行业作为全球重要的农产品之一，其供应量的增长将直接影响市场价格和行业竞争格局。

body: Milk collection has so far exceeded expectations in many major producing regions. The Ornua Global Dairy Market Report for October estimates that global supply increased by about 1.4% in August, although the pace is expected to weaken as drought in Europe and El Niño-related conditions affect production. The report puts the expected increase for 2027 at 1%. It says the eventual effect of El Niño is “currently unknown”, while higher oil prices, inflation and interest rates represent a “considerable” source of macroeconomic uncertainty. European dairy markets have remained relatively stable despite strong global availability. Milk output in the European Union rose by 1.1% in September, compared with 2.5% in August. Volumes were above expectations despite dry conditions, prompting the report to restore the bloc’s annual production estimate to its pre-drought level of 1.9%. body: Fonterra has moved its energy complaint from the cost line to the continuity line. In this year’s Mood of the Boardroom, managing director co-operative affairs Matt Bolger warns that prolonged energy outages could threaten dairy processing . Coming from the company behind $25 billion in FY2026 export earnings , that is not a household-bill gripe. It is a supply-chain risk sitting under New Zealand’s largest export sector. The shift in language matters. In August 2024, when hydro lakes ran low and gas tightened, wholesale prices doubled over three weeks to exceed $900/MWh . BusinessDesk reported prices trading above $800/MWh, up from roughly $150/MWh . Fonterra’s then-COO Anna Palairet said at the time the co-op was “confident that energy remains available to process milk” , but that the situation was adding significant cost “as we cannot simply pause operations.” That last line is the whole story. Milk does not wait. A factory that loses power at peak season is not deferring production, it is losing it. In 2024 the concern was margin. In 2026 Fonterra is openly questioning availability. Bolger’s broader pitch is about growth: strong US demand for New Zealand dairy protein, rising capital and IT spend, and a $1 billion investment in South Island value-add ingredients . Those premium ingredient customers pay for reliability. A multinational food company that misses a production run because a New Zealand supplier could not keep its plant running will remember. That risk is sharper because the country’s trade position is narrow. Bolger estimates New Zealand has access to only around 14% of global dairy consumption at tariffs below 10% . When you cannot win on market access, you win on dependability. Lose that and the premium goes with it. And with $19.6 billion of the $25 billion flowing back into the domestic economy, roughly 78 cents in every export dollar, the exposure is not just Fonterra’s. This is not a company asking someone else to fix its problems. Fonterra’s FY25 annual report showed it retired its last coal boiler in November 2024 , committed $150 million to electrify North Island sites including a $64 million electrode boiler at Whareroa, and spent $104 million in FY25 on energy security and decarbonisation out of $635 million in essential capex. Here is the irony business readers should notice.

body: While physical availability expands, global commodity pricing faces sustained headwinds from cooling international import demand, domestic consumer price sensitivity, and broad macroeconomic inflation. Although spot skim milk powder and wholesale cheese values demonstrated seasonal stability through early autumn, substantial price rallies heading into the fourth quarter remain unlikely. For Iowa—which has ascended into the ranks of the top ten dairy-producing states with a milking herd of approximately 245, 000 cows—global trade headwinds intersect with massive regional processing investments. Over $13 billion in new capital commitments across the wider United States dairy processing landscape, particularly in modern cheese plants across the Upper Midwest, provides a critical regional buffer that can absorb expanding local liquid milk pools even as global export off-take slows. From an animal science and herd genetics standpoint, commercial farm operators face complex management tradeoffs between short-term livestock revenues and replacement pipeline security. Continued strength in feeder cattle prices has driven extensive adoption of beef-on-dairy crossbreeding programs across commercial herds, delivering lucrative supplemental cash receipts for day-old crossbred calves. However, prolonged prioritization of terminal beef crosses has caused national dairy replacement heifer inventories to contract to historic lows. With dairy heifer availability severely constrained and replacement purchase costs elevated, farm managers must carefully balance terminal crossbreeding ratios against female herd retention needs to maintain milking string capacity and avoid involuntary herd liquidation. From an enterprise finance and operational budgeting perspective, managing farmgate margins requires shifting operational focus from gross liquid volume toward milk component density. Under Federal Milk Marketing Order multiple component pricing formulas, butterfat and protein yield dictates the vast majority of gross farm income, with regional cheese vats paying substantial premiums for high-solids milk. While moderating corn and soybean meal prices provide welcome ration-cost relief, non-feed operating expenditures—including diesel fuel, agricultural machinery maintenance, labor wages, and bulk milk hauling assessments—remain elevated.

body: By Peter Kerr Aug 20 (BusinessDesk) - Fonterra Cooperative Group, the world’s biggest exporter of dairy products, achieved record export in the final three months of its season of 620,000 tonnes. Its 2012 May, June and July shipments were 36% more than the same period last year, reinforcing the 2011/2012 record milk production by its 10,500 dairy farmer members. Total milk production was up 10% on 2010/2011. “We traditionally ship just over 450,000 tonnes at this time of year, but we’ve had a lot more product to move, and this has meant some creative planning across the wider supply chain to manage and store the additional volumes,” said Fonterra NZ Milk Products managing director, Gary Romano. “For the first time since Fonterra was formed, we chartered our own break-bulk vessel to send product to the Middle East.” Romano said that though dairy product demand usually lifts ahead of the Islamic month of Ramadan, the demand spike was more than expected. “There was not enough available container capacity at that time of year,” he said. “This meant Fonterra had to charter its own vessel to take 7,500 tonnes of products to ports in Dubai and Saudi.” Romano said the new dairy season has now begun. body: A tropical drink for gut health, an iron-support capsule and a protein-packed soda. Fonterra-backed Vivici is offering a taste of where everyday nutrition could be heading, with products designed to fit around people’s lives. The Dutch company will showcase its latest concepts at SupplySide Global in Las Vegas this month. They’re ideas for brands to develop, rather than products heading straight onto supermarket shelves. At the heart of its wellness pitch is lactoferrin, an iron-binding protein sometimes called “pink gold”. Vivici makes it through precision fermentation and is exploring its potential in supporting iron balance and gut health. One concept combines lactoferrin with iron and vitamin C; another puts it into a coconut-and-golden-pineapple drink mix with prebiotic fibre and probiotics. For consumers, the appeal could be a simple daily addition with a clear purpose, provided the finished products deliver on their promise. For those looking to lift their protein intake, Vivici is also showing an Italian lemon soda and a small mangosteen lassi shot delivering 25g of protein in just 100ml. These use its separate BLG whey protein ingredient, rather than lactoferrin. The attraction is easy to see: more choice beyond the familiar thick shake, especially for people who want their protein in something refreshing or small enough to drink in a few mouthfuls. For New Zealand, Fonterra’s involvement makes this particularly interesting. Through its stake in Vivici, the dairy co-operative has a foothold in producing valuable dairy proteins without extracting them from cows milk. That could open additional opportunities in health, wellness and active nutrition, extending the ways its protein expertise reaches consumers. Lactoferrin supplements already exist, so this is no clear-cut world first. The more useful question is whether fermentation can make these ingredients accessible to more people. Taste, price and credible benefits will decide that. A good concept gets attention at a trade show. A product people enjoy, can afford and find useful earns a place in the daily routine.

body: Like New Zealand producers, Ireland’s meat industry is looking to the dairy industry to address falling cattle numbers. A pan-industry group has established a trial farm to provide management advice for farmers finishing dairy-beef cross calves. Each year about 900,000 cattle surplus to Ireland’s dairy industry end up in the beef herd, with another 120,000 to 180,000 young calves exported live to Europe. Data from Ireland’s Central Statistics Office shows total cattle numbers have fallen from 7.3 million in 2023 to 6.9 million in 2025. Between 2024 and 2025 the number of dairy cows fell 2.2% and beef cattle by 5.7% due to declining numbers of farmed livestock and increased live exports. Agriculture and Food Development Authority (Teagasc) researcher Dr Nicky Byrne said that “with shrinking beef cow numbers globally, the opportunity to finish domestically provided dairy animals aligns with the grass-fed beef model we have here in Ireland”. The average Irish dairy beef farmer raises 32 calves. A 3.3kg improvement in current animal weight through better beef genetics could increase returns by about NZ$50. A consortium of research and industry bodies, Teagasc, Shinagh Estates Ltd and Dawn Meats, have leased a 138 hectare farm and established the Tipperary dairy calf-to-beef demonstration farm. It became Ballyvadin Beef Farm Ltd in 2022, an independent, standalone commercial entity that, said Byrne, demonstrates best practice to farmers. Of the 134ha, 113ha is used for the dairy beef and 12ha for cereals, with crops sold but the straw retained. A further 16ha is dedicated to hedgerows. Byrne said in 2024 54% of dairy calves in Ireland were from a beef sire, and at last mating a third of dairy AI serves used sexed semen, up from 25% the previous year. The use of sexed semen is growing sharply, which allows for greater use of higher genetic merit beef semen earlier in the breeding season, ensuring those animals are appropriate for the beef industry. Nine dairy farmers supplied calves for the trial and Byrne said traditionally they favour early maturing Angus and Hereford breeds, but researchers are also testing Aubrac, Limousin and Charolais. A Dairy Beef Index measure is used to identify those with a balance of both calving and carcase traits.

title: Milk powder gains fuel GDT price surge
summary: 三种类型和六个交付期的奶粉价格上涨，将全球乳制品贸易价格指数推高了2.5%，这是自去年二月以来的最大涨幅。全脂奶粉上涨4.4%，脱脂奶粉上涨3.4%，黄油奶粉上涨8.4%。马苏里拉奶酪价格上涨1.3%，奶粉价格的强劲势头将足以修订新西兰乳制品季节高峰的农场门口牛奶价格预测。恒天然可能在11月12日的年度股东大会之前进行修订。在最新拍卖的最新消息方面，切达奶酪下跌7.4%，无水乳脂下跌3.4%，黄油下跌0.4%。
author: Hugh Stringleman
title_zh: 奶粉价格上涨推动GDT价格飙升
points: 中国购买需求强劲
body: Rising prices for milk powder across three types and six delivery periods have boosted the Global Dairy Trade price index by 2.5%, the biggest rise since last February. Whole milk powder jumped 4.4%, skim milk powder by 3.4% and butter milk powder was up 8.4%. Along with mozzarella prices being up 1.3%, the strength in milk powder prices will be enough to revise upwards the farmgate milk price forecasts at the peak of the New Zealand dairy season. Fonterra may revise before its annual shareholders meeting on November 12. On the negative side of the latest auction, cheddar was down 7.4%, anhydrous milk fat down 3.4% and butter down 0.4%. NZX Dairy Insights said that strong buying from China was behind the milk powder price increases, with just over half of the volume going that way, especially in the near-term contract periods. “NZ milk production data released hours ahead of the GDT event saw a 1.9% rise in milksolids and a new record for September collections,” NZX analyst Rosalind Crickett said. “However, the growth trajectory seems to be slowing, with reports on the ground noting that North Island regions appear to be experiencing a drier than normal spring, with risks of El Niño in early to mid summer still being priced in, in the background. “With the largest price increases seen in C1 November delivery, last-minute restocking ahead of the festive season could also be at play, particularly with potential concerns of product accessibility in the months to come amid a backdrop of drought and ongoing geopolitical tensions.” The global demand for whey protein is also generating more cheese products and GDT cheddar prices plummeted as inventories and export volumes grow.

title: NZ considers WTO action over Canadian dairy subsidies
summary: 如果新的贸易谈判无法尽快解决这一问题，新西兰可能对损害性的加拿大牛奶补贴发起法律挑战。新西兰乳制品行业已经两年在呼吁政府将案件提交给世界贸易组织，以解决加拿大补贴乳制品生产“紧急”问题，该问题正在损害其在美国和其他市场的出口成员。新西兰乳制品公司协会（DCANZ）对政府周一宣布的年度“贸易和投资对话”表示只有有限的支持，该对话旨在加强贸易并“解决两国之间具有挑战性的国际和国内贸易问题。
author: Nigel Stirling
title_zh: 新西兰考虑对加拿大乳制品补贴采取WTO行动
body: A legal challenge by New Zealand against damaging Canadian milk subsidies could be on the cards if new trade talks cannot resolve the matter soon. The NZ dairy industry has for two years been calling on the government to take a case to the World Trade Organisation to address the “urgent” problem of subsidised Canadian dairy production undercutting its exporter members in the United States and other markets. The Dairy Companies Association (DCANZ) would give only qualified support to the government’s announcement on Monday of an annual “trade and investment dialogue” to boost trade and “work through challenging international and domestic trade issues” between the two countries. “DCANZ welcomes efforts to strengthen trade with Canada but says a process of annual talks will be too slow to resolve pressing dairy concerns,” chief executive Kimberly Crewther said. “Canada’s subsidised dairy exports are already harming NZ exporters in global protein markets.” Farmers Weekly understands the first talks between Trade Minister Todd McClay and his Canadian counterpart could come as early as next month’s meeting of APEC trade ministers in Shenzhen, China. “We are going to give it a real shot to try and work it through but if it does not work then we reserve the right to take other action and we are getting closer to the end where those options are getting fewer,” a source close to the Beehive said. In the meantime, lawyers at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade are finalising their advice to ministers on NZ’s chances of success at the WTO. Recruitment of other dairy exporting countries to potentially join NZ as litigants is ongoing. The insider conceded that the recent escalation of tit-for-tat tariffs between the United States and Canada meant NZ would be pressing the issue of reform to its milk pricing system at a “sensitive” time for the Canadians. However, Crewther said the US-Canada trade war had the potential to raise the costs to NZ exporters of Canada’s dairy policies even further. The association has previously estimated that the cost of reducing margins on high-value protein products to compete with subsidised Canadian competitors was depressing NZ exporters’ returns by $256 million annually.
points: 新西兰可能对加拿大乳制品补贴发起法律挑战
新西兰乳制品行业呼吁政府将案件提交给世界贸易组织

title: Dairy technology helps Dutch farmer cut costs
summary: 在荷兰东部Groenlo附近的马arten和Corine Pleiter的乳制品农场，利润空间很紧。作为第四代农场主，Pleiter是技术帮助他在经济上取得平衡的倡导者。这个家族饲养220头奶牛，去年生产了210万至220万升牛奶，蛋白质含量为3.8%，脂肪含量为4.9%。但他们的生产成本几乎直接等于他们的收入，每升98美分。Pleiter表示，荷兰的平均生产成本约为每升1.04美元。
author: Neal Wallace
title_zh: 乳制品技术帮助荷兰农民降低成本
points: 技术监测提高效率
body: The margins are tight on Maarten and Corine Pleiter’s dairy farm near Groenlo in the eastern Netherlands. The fourth generation to farm the 28 hectare property, Pleiter is an advocate of technology to help tilt the economic balance in his favour. The family milk 220 cows and last year produced between 2.1 and 2.2 million litres of milk with 3.8% protein and 4.9% fat. But their costs of production almost directly equates with their income of NZ$98c/litre. Pleiter said the average cost of production in the Netherlands is about NZ$1.04/litre. Dutch farmers also receive basic support from the government and funding for environmental initiatives. A fluctuating milk prices does not help. In 2025 they received NZ$1.20 per litre. It then fell to NZ$1/L and in January slumped to NZ$82c/L before lifting slightly. Pleiter sees technology as essential to securing a future for him and his young family. “It makes your daily life easier and adds value,” he said, speaking to Farmers Weekly on his flat but picturesque farm. Pleiter’s is a testing farm for Dutch software company Nedap. The farm bristles with new Nedap technology, such as the SmartSort drafting gate, which is controlled through tags on individual cow collars, or CowControl, on the cows. The same collars are linked to SmartFlow, a system that monitors the yield and milk flow system in the parlour. They have also installed SmartSight, a 3D camera that assesses the cows every time they leave the milking parlour for signs of potential lameness.

title: Fonterra farmers increase use of fixed milk pricing
summary: 恒天然奶农本季使用固定奶价服务的频率提升，已通过八次活动签约超过1.25亿公斤乳固体。这一数字超过以往任何季节，且十一月和十二月还有两次活动。十月的价格风险管理活动吸引了630份申请，分配超过1900万公斤乳固体，其中1700万公斤在本季，220万公斤在2027-28赛季。当前赛季的固定奶价为每公斤10.03美元（不含服务费），收到超过400份申请，涉及1600多万公斤。
author: Hugh Stringleman
title_zh: 恒天然农民增加固定牛奶定价使用
points: 农民寻求稳定收入
减少市场风险敞口
body: Fonterra farmers are using its fixed milk price services at a greater rate this season, having contracted over 125 million kg milksolids in eight events so far. That total surpasses previous seasons with two more monthly events to come, in November and December. The October price risk management event drew 630 applications across three services and more than 19 million kg was allocated, 17 million in the current season and 2.2 million in the 2027-28 season. The fixed milk price for the current season in the October offering was $10.03/kg net of the service fee and over 400 applications were received for more than 16 million kg. The milk price range option at $9.60 to $10.50 received over 50 applications and over 1 million kg was allocated. For the 2027-28 fixed price of net $9.94 over 175 applications were received for 7.39 million kg and 2.2 million kg was allocated, necessitating a scaling back of the application amounts. Fonterra’s head of milk supply, Lisa Payne, said it is encouraging to see farmers making the most of these services. “The strong uptake tells us farmers are placing value on certainty and risk management. “Volumes contracted through our price risk management services have already exceeded previous annual records, despite the season still having two pricing events remaining. “Farmers can’t control market volatility, but they can reduce their exposure to it.” In two previous seasons the total contracts with farmers were 120 million kg in 2024 across 10 events and 114 million kg in 2025 over 10 events, including 10 million for the additional season (2026) option. Year to date, 113 million kg has been contracted in the current season and 13.6 million for the next season (2027).

title: Fonterra announces Chief Financial Officer resignation
summary: 安德鲁于2023年加入恒天然，担任全球市场业务的商业总监，2024年成为恒天然的首席财务官。自那时以来，他帮助监督了Mainland集团的剥离、恒天然的企业资源规划转型以及多项其他关键举措，这些举措为合作社的未来奠定了基础。首席执行官理查德·艾伦表示：“我想感谢安德鲁的贡献和领导。他为合作社进行的重要变革带来了清晰度、纪律性和动力。同时，他加强了我们的财务能力，并建立了一支能力很强的团队。我们祝他在新职位上取得成功。
title_zh: 恒天然宣布首席财务官辞职
points: 恒天然宣布财务官辞职
body: Andrew joined the Co-op as Commercial Director of Fonterra’s Global Markets business in 2023, before becoming Fonterra’s Chief Financial Officer in 2024. Since then, he has helped oversee the divestment of Mainland Group, Fonterra’s enterprise resource planning transformation, and a number of other key initiatives that position the Co-op for the future. CEO Richard Allen says, “I would like to thank Andrew for his contribution and leadership. He has brought clarity, discipline and momentum to important changes the Co-op has undertaken. At the same time, he has strengthened our finance capability and built a highly capable team. We wish him success in his new role.” Andrew will remain with Fonterra until the end of the calendar year, supporting a smooth transition. Recruitment for Fonterra’s next Chief Financial Officer will begin immediately. For further information contact: Fonterra Communications 24-hour media line Phone: +64 21 507 072

title: Fonterra annual meeting has voting schedule
summary: 恒天然股东年度会议将于11月12日举行，大部分关注点集中在选举两位农民董事上。四名候选人中，连任董事凯茜·奎因寻求第三个任期，新加入者杰西·陈、马克·考克斯和彼得·莫伊尼汉。每位股东可投票给一名或两名候选人，但不超过两名，采用得票多者当选制。恒天然年度会议通知列出了全国九个会议的时间和地点，以听取董事候选人在10月22日至30日期间发言。所有四名候选人的独立评估小组报告、属性和技能矩阵，以及详细的职业细节和简介声明也已发布。
author: Hugh Stringleman
title_zh: 恒天然年度会议确定董事投票安排
body: Fonterra’s annual meeting of shareholders will be a hybrid meeting on November 12 with most interest surrounding the election of two farmer-directors from among four candidates. Those candidates are two-term director Cathy Quinn, seeking a third term, and newcomers Jessie Chan, Mark Cox and Peter Moynihan. Each shareholder may vote for one or two candidates, but no more, in a first-past-the-post format. Fonterra’s annual meeting notice has the times and places for nine meetings throughout the country to hear from director candidates over the period October 22 to 30. Reports of the independent assessment panel on all four candidates, the attributes and skills matrix, along with extensive career details and profile statements, have also been published. Voting will take place to ratify the appointment of Holly Kramer as an appointed director, seeking a third term, and former chief financial officer Jonathan Mason for the first time. Shareholders who cannot attend in person or online and are eligible to vote can cast their vote online, by post, or by way of proxy or representative. The meeting will begin at 10.30am in the Mystery Creek Events Centre, Hamilton, and online. Brent Goldsack is stepping down from the board, having served the maximum nine years or three terms. Next year chair Peter McBride and fellow long-serving director John Nicholls will be required to step down, leaving a board lighter on experience and needing a new chair. The chair must be one of the six elected farmer-directors, two of whom are being elected this year and two next year. The annual meeting will also be asked to approve the Co-operative Council programme and budget of $3.4 million. The annual meeting will be addressed for the first time by new chief executive Richard Allen and Co-operative Council chair John Stevenson.
points: 恒天然年度会议将于11月12日举行

title: Leon Fung takes Synlait’s top job as turnaround continues
summary: Leon Fung被任命为Synlait的首席执行官，此前担任代理CEO五个月。他自2024年6月以来一直是Synlait的董事，并在主席乔治·亚当斯的请求下接替理查德·怀特。Fung表示，在董事会两年的经历让他对Synlait的挑战和机遇有了很好的理解，这给了他带领团队推动变革的信心。他还支持自己在乳制品加工技术方面的经验，以帮助Synlait向前发展。
author: Gerald Piddock
title_zh: Leon Fung出任Synlait总裁 转型持续进行中
body: Leon Fung has been appointed CEO of Synlait after serving as acting CEO for the past five months. Prior to that, he was a director of Synlait since June 2024 and was asked by chair George Adams to take on the role after Richard Wyeth resigned . “Two years on the board gave me a good understanding and insight of Synlait’s challenges and opportunities. That gave me the confidence to lead a team to drive change,” Fung said. “We are making progress and I look forward to navigating the challenges and capitalising on the opportunities ahead, so we return Synlait to success.” He also backs his experience in the technical side of dairy processing to help drive Synlait forward. “I felt that not only did the business and board need my help, but I also feel I can do it.” Adams said Fung has demonstrated strong leadership and commercial discipline with a deep knowledge of dairy processing, which has helped deliver Synlait’s operational stability since his appointment as acting CEO. “This appointment provides continuity, clarity and momentum as the company continues to execute its recovery roadmap.” Fung came to New Zealand from China 30 years ago and studied food technology at Massey University. He got his first job working for a dairy company in Whangārei as a plant operator and later as a technologist before moving to Wellington to work for the New Zealand Dairy Board. In early 2000 he moved to China to take up a job for Tetra Pak in its processing division and saw firsthand the major growth phase its dairy industry took at the time. “I worked with many Chinese dairy companies to build factories for them, give them the turnkey solution. Tetra Pak overall helped the dairy industry growth in China a lot.” In 2012, he returned to New Zealand, working for Yashili, where he helped build its dairy factory in Pōkeno. “The investment in Pōkeno was a very good one. I built several factories in the past and that one is definitely a very high standard.”

title: Why dairy drinks are well placed to capitalise on the benefit stacking trend
summary: 乳制品饮料行业正迎来利益叠加趋势，这一趋势为乳制品饮料提供了良好的发展机遇。利益叠加指的是产品同时具备多种健康或功能性卖点，满足消费者多元化需求。这一趋势对乳制品饮料行业从业者具有重要意义，意味着需要不断创新产品，提升健康价值，以满足市场变化。乳制品饮料因其天然的营养成分，在健康趋势中具有天然优势，适合利用利益叠加策略进行市场推广。

title: Change in Directors appointed by Bright Dairy - BusinessDesk
summary: 刘瑞兵（Ryan）因个人原因辞去光明乳业控股有限公司（光明乳业）首席财务官职务，并已停止担任光明乳业任命的Synlait Milk Limited（Synlait）董事，鉴于其已停止在光明乳业的雇佣关系。光明乳业将适时提供Ryan继任者的更新。Ryan的辞职立即生效。光明乳业在Synlait的持股比例为39.0%。对于从业者而言，这意味着需关注乳业高层变动对行业格局的影响。
title_zh: 贝因美任命新董事

title: 罗普斯金2.07亿收购盟萤科技，盈利持续承压再靠跨界补利润 ｜并购一线
summary: 罗普斯金以2.0655亿元收购盟萤科技51%股权，后者主营面板、半导体产业的自动物料搬运设备及核心零部件。此举旨在缓解建筑主业利润下滑压力，通过并购实现业务多元化。收购后盟萤科技将纳入罗普斯金合并报表，但市场反应不佳，收购次日股价跌停。罗普斯金近年通过并购转型，包括收购建筑智能化和检测业务，但效果有限。盟萤科技在国产替代背景下有发展空间，但竞争激烈。交易对赌协议显示盟萤科技未来业绩承诺较高，罗普斯金期待借此提升整体盈利能力。

title_zh: 罗普斯金2.07亿收购盟萤科技，盈利持续承压再靠跨界补利润
points: 罗普斯金收购盟萤科技
body: 10月25日，罗普斯金（002333.SZ）公告，拟以现金2.0655亿元收购苏州盟萤电子科技有限公司（下称“盟萤科技”）51%股权。收购标的主要为面板、半导体产业提供自动物料搬运设备及核心零部件。交易完成后，盟萤科技将纳入上市公司合并报表。消息披露次日（10月26日），罗普斯金股价低开低走，以跌停价收盘，报4.86元。 此前，建筑主业利润变薄时，公司沿产业链进行的转型未能扭转盈利压力，罗普斯金因此把并购的目光投向了更远的地方，在跨界收购检测业务时尝到了甜头，但这块业务很快也走弱。在主业与检测业务双双承压之下，公司再次启动跨界并购，试图通过买入已有客户、订单和盈利的盟萤科技，为业绩补上新的“利润补丁”。 盟萤科技成立于2010年，主要从事自动物料搬运系统（AMHS）相关业务。这类业务主要服务于面板、半导体等特定制造场景，承担洁净工厂内部的物料搬运和存储工作。设备搬运晶圆和面板时，既要快、稳，也要避免灰尘影响产品质量。工厂扩产和自动化改造会用到它，但供应商必须先通过客户测试，才能拿到订单。 公司目前已经积累了一批面板客户。据昆山市融媒体中心报道，盟萤科技为京东方、华星光电、天马等企业提供智能仓储与物流解决方案，并在此基础上向半导体制造领域延伸。公司在拥有现成客户的同时还有进一步的拓展空间，这也是罗普斯金选择出手并购的一个重要原因。 而在面板、半导体两类市场中，盟萤科技所处的产业链位置也有所不同：创始人史延库在2025年的访谈中介绍，公司在面板领域直接服务终端工厂；在半导体领域，则主要为系统集成商、天车企业供应存储设备、升降设备及零部件，通过向自动化设备商供应设备和零部件的方式切入半导体市场。 从赛道格局来看，盟萤科技的利润空间主要是来自于国产替代。国际上，半导体AMHS市场长期由大福、村田等日本厂商主导。2025年，大福、村田合计占据全球约90%的市场份额。在国内市场，有弥费等国内企业已完成8英寸、12英寸晶圆厂的整厂系统交付，2025年弥费在中国大陆市场的份额约为3.72%。由此看，盟萤科技的机会在于跟随国产集成商进入更多产线，竞争的关键也落在了产品可靠性、交付能力和客户关系上。 对罗普斯金而言，盟萤科技最直接的吸引力，就是公司已经在赚钱了。2025年，盟萤科技营收约1.65亿元，净利润2162万元。此次交易对应整体作价4.05亿元，约为18.7倍PE。 从对赌协议期限结构来看，标的方主压一年后业绩爆发。交易对方承诺，2026年至2028年，盟萤科技按扣非前后归母净利润孰低口径计算的净利润，分别不低于2200万元、3500万元和4425万元。其中，2027年的承诺较前一年多出近六成。 罗普斯金起家于建筑铝型材，业务主打门窗、幕墙等建筑场景。自从房地产与建筑行业进入漫长的寒冬，公司的利润空间持续受到挤压。为拓宽收入和利润来源，公司在2020年开始并购转型。 起初，公司还是从主业内寻找利润点：2020年12月，公司收购中亿丰科技，进入建筑智能化；2021年12月，完成对方正检测的收购，切入建设工程检测。从卖材料延伸到做工程、做服务，公司增加了业务环节，但主要客户需求仍来自建筑领域。 2022年，罗普斯金成立光伏边框事业部，将铝加工能力延伸至新能源产业。彼时光伏行业快速发展，公司希望借此打开新的增长空间。 但以上转型没能让公司摆脱压力。2022年，公司归母净亏损约4925万元；2023年扭亏，2024年归母净利润仍在5100万元左右。但检测业务已经有了回报：2022年至2024年，方正检测累计实现扣非净利润约4707万元，超过收购时的业绩承诺。罗普斯金首次在这次跨界尝到了并购成熟业务的甜头。 2025年，公司继续加码检测。8月签约收购中城绿脉65%股权，9月将其纳入合并范围，检测版图由建设工程进一步延伸至特种设备。中城绿脉后来更名为中亿午简，从收购日至当年年底实现净利润约1243万元。并购虽然带来了新利润，但罗普斯金2025年全年归母净利润为5333万元，仍未明显拉开与此前两年的差距。 到了2026年，主业的利润空间继续缩小，部分新业务也出现了亏损。上半年，建筑型材和铝合金门窗毛利率分别降至7%和6.12%；此前布局的光伏边框业务也遭遇行业低谷，收入同比腰斩，毛利率降至负4.91%。公司曾寄望于借光伏打开增量市场，如今却成了利润拖累。

title: Danone joins Nestlé and Coca-Cola in labelling changes
summary: 达能根据欧盟委员会打击潜在漂绿行动的举措，修订了塑料瓶回收声明。这一变化反映了乳制品行业对可持续发展和环保责任的重视，对跨境母婴行业的从业者意味着需要关注并调整产品包装和营销策略，以符合国际环保标准，避免市场风险。这类事件通常意味着行业在追求更高品质和更细分的市场满足，从业者需紧跟技术发展和消费者需求变化，以保持竞争力。

title: 买奶粉京东和淘宝哪个便宜？2026双十一奶粉囤货省钱攻略 - 新浪财经
summary: 京东和淘宝在奶粉品类优惠机制不同，京东以自营直降加平台补贴为主，淘宝侧重跨店满减和店铺券叠加。双十一期间，京东通过红包、品类券、开门红等环节提供直接补贴，而淘宝则依赖预售定金和平台满减。对跨境母婴从业者而言，需关注线上渠道价格战对市场格局的影响，以及消费者购买行为的变化。从10月12日晚8点起，京东双十一正式拉开帷幕，用户每天都可以在活动页面领取额外惊喜红包，单日最高可领60元。
source_name: Google News·线上渠道与大促（中文）
title_zh: 买奶粉京东和淘宝哪个便宜？2026双十一奶粉囤货省钱攻略
points: 京东与淘宝奶粉价格比较
2026双十一奶粉囤货省钱攻略
电商平台价格竞争
body: 家里有娃的父母都懂，奶粉是刚需中的刚需，一罐动辄两三百，一年下来花销不小。每到双十一，很多宝爸宝妈都会纠结同一个问题：买奶粉到底京东便宜还是淘宝便宜？实际上，这个问题没有绝对答案。两家平台的优惠机制截然不同，京东走的是自营直降加平台补贴路线，淘宝则侧重跨店满减和店铺券叠加。同一款奶粉，在不同时间节点、使用不同优惠组合，最终到手价可能相差几十甚至上百元。关键在于掌握各自的活动节奏和隐藏入口，而不是简单地比标价。 今年京东双十一已经全面启动，购买奶粉之前有一个必须要知道的入口：在京东App搜索框中输入 热卖福利 ，即可进入双十一专属会场。这个密令会贯穿整个大促周期，是领取各类补贴和红包的核心通道。 10月12日晚8点，双11京东开启！每天领60元额外惊喜红包！ 从10月12日晚8点起，京东双十一正式拉开帷幕，用户每天都可以在活动页面领取额外惊喜红包，单日最高可领60元。对于需要囤奶粉的家庭来说，从这一刻开始就可以持续积累红包额度，红包可在后续购买奶粉时直接抵扣，相当于提前锁定了部分优惠。 京东惊喜日 在10月中旬的多个时段，京东会不定时推出惊喜日活动，母婴品类往往是被重点覆盖的类目之一。惊喜日期间，部分奶粉品牌会放出限时直降或满减补贴，配合此前积累的红包使用，可以打出不错的组合优惠。建议在这个阶段把目标奶粉加入购物车，随时关注价格波动。 京东10.30开门红超级补贴日 10月30日是今年京东双十一开门红的核心爆发节点，超级补贴日当天，平台会集中释放大额品类券和品牌券。奶粉作为母婴核心品类，通常会有专属的满999减150甚至更大力度补贴。如果计划一次性囤够几个月的量，开门红这天下单的性价比往往最高。 京东多买多返更便宜 开门红之后，京东会推出多买多返机制，购买指定奶粉达到一定件数或金额门槛，即可获得额外的返利或赠品。对于配方固定的家庭，多罐装、整箱装在这个阶段的综合单价往往优于单罐购买。返利形式通常是京东或者品牌赠品，实际折算下来每罐能再省十几到二十几元。 京东明星红包 进入11月上旬，京东明星红包玩法上线，部分奶粉品牌会联合明星代言人发放专属红包或加赠权益。红包面额和获取方式各品牌不同，但叠加此前积累的平台红包和品类券使用，依然能让到手价进一步下探。 从上表可以清晰看出，整个京东双十一的奶粉购买节奏是从积累红包、到惊喜日试探价格、再到开门红集中下单、最后通过多买多返和明星红包查漏补缺。每一个环节都可以通过搜索 热卖福利 进入会场参与。 淘宝和天猫今年双十一的节奏与往年类似，整体仍然以跨店满减为核心机制。奶粉主要集中在天猫母婴旗舰店和天猫国际进口奶粉两个渠道。天猫的玩法侧重预售定金翻倍、店铺优惠券叠加平台满减，以及88VIP专属折扣。对于有明确目标品牌且愿意花时间凑单的消费者来说，淘宝天猫的满减体系在购买多品牌、多品类商品时能摊薄成本。但奶粉这类单品价值高、品牌集中度强的品类，平台满减的边际收益有时不如京东自营的直接补贴来得直观。淘宝系的优势更多体现在进口小众奶粉品牌和临期特卖渠道上，如果恰好有对应需求，可以关注天猫国际的双十一预售专场。 综合来看，京东在奶粉品类上的核心优势集中体现在两个方面：一是自营渠道的正品保障体系成熟，从采购到仓储到配送全链路可控，家长买得放心；二是在双十一期间的优惠路径清晰直接，不需要复杂的凑单计算，通过平台补贴、品类券、红包三重叠加就能拿到很有竞争力的价格。现在正值双十一，通过搜索 热卖福利 即可参与从红包领取到开门红补贴再到多买多返的全周期优惠活动。对于奶粉这种高频刚需、对正品要求极高的品类而言，京东在当前大促节点确实是一个值得优先考虑的平台。当然，最终省钱多少还取决于每个家庭的实际购买习惯——善用活动入口、提前规划囤货周期、在关键节点果断下单，才是把奶粉支出真正降下来的不二法门。

title: Synlait Names Leon Fung Permanent Chief Executive - Dairynews.today
summary: 新西兰乳企Synlait任命Leon Fung为永久首席执行官。这一人事变动可能预示着Synlait在战略方向、市场拓展或运营管理上将有新的调整。对于跨境母婴行业的从业者来说，Synlait作为新西兰重要乳企，其管理层变动可能影响产品供应和价格策略，需持续关注其后续发展。
title_zh: Synlait任命Leon Fung为永久首席执行官
points: Synlait任命Leon Fung为CEO
可能预示战略方向调整
需关注产品供应和价格策略变动
body: Leon Fung has taken permanent charge of Synlait Milk, following a five-month period as interim chief executive. He joined the company’s board in June 2024 and assumed executive responsibilities after Richard Wyeth left the chief executive position. The board said the decision would provide continuity while Synlait addresses its finances and reshapes its strategy. Fung has more than 30 years of experience in dairy processing, food technology and commercial management across Australasia and Greater China. He began his career as a plant operator and technologist in Whangārei after studying food technology at Massey University. He later worked on processing-equipment engineering and turnkey projects for Tetra Pak during the expansion of China’s dairy industry. Discover new market opportunities, exchange expertise, build valuable business connections, and discuss the future of the dairy industry in one of the region’s most dynamic markets. Register here: https://menadc.dairynews.today His previous senior roles included responsibility for Yashili’s nutritional-powder plant in Pōkeno, Nutricia’s infant-formula manufacturing operations, Danone New Zealand and NiG Nutritionals. Synlait’s facilities include spray-drying plants in Dunsandel and specialist packaging operations in Auckland. Fung’s background includes cleanroom production, automated drying systems and compliance requirements for international infant-nutrition manufacturing. The appointment comes after several quarters in which Synlait experienced commercial volatility and adjusted product volumes. The company reported improving activity in specialised ingredients during the later months of the 2026 financial year, including pharmaceutical-grade lactoferrin, adult nutrition powders and clinical products. It is also revising its manufacturing arrangement for infant formula supplied to China in response to updated registration requirements and changing demographic conditions in East Asia. Synlait has been directing capacity towards specialised protein fractionation and consumer-packaging products. Earlier in the year, it undertook debt restructuring and recapitalisation measures.

title: MARKET CLOSE: NZ shares rise ahead of final election results; Synlait, A2, Fonterra drop - BusinessDesk
summary: 新西兰股市在最终选举结果公布前上涨，Synlait、A2、Fonterra等乳企股价下跌。这一市场波动反映了投资者对乳业公司未来业绩的预期变化。对跨境母婴行业从业者而言，需密切关注新西兰乳业市场动态，特别是主要乳企的股价变化可能预示着行业竞争格局和供应链成本的未来走向。
title_zh: 新西兰股市收盘上涨，Synlait、A2、Fonterra股价下跌
points: Synlait、A2、Fonterra股价下跌
市场波动反映投资者预期
需关注乳业竞争格局和供应链成本变化
body: Oct. 6 (BusinessDesk) - New Zealand shares gained, led by Meridian Energy and Port of Tauranga, as investors keep an eye on tomorrow's final count of the general election and the subsequent coalition talks, while dairy stocks Synlait Milk and A2 Milk Co gave up gains. The S&P/NZX50 Index rose 2.64 points, or 0.03 percent, to 7,977.34. Within the index, 25 stocks rose, 20 fell and five were unchanged. Turnover was $155.6 million. "It's a quiet day leading into tomorrow's update on the special votes - that's probably related, people are waiting to see what happens over the weekend and in negotiations through to the 12th," said James Lindsay, senior portfolio manager at Nikko Asset Management. "If there is a marked move to one side or the other, you would see currency movements first." Meridian Energy led the index, up 2.5 percent to $2.89, while Port of Tauranga gained 2.1 percent to $4.39 and Sanford rose 1.9 percent to $8. Synlait Milk was the worst performer, down 2.6 percent to $6.72, and A2 Milk Co dropped 1.4 percent to $7.16, both falling from record highs. The two stocks have gained since last Thursday on confirmation that their brands and recipes have gained registration in China, removing an obstacle in a market with soaring sales, before both giving up gains yesterday. They have had strong years so far, rising 122 percent and 241 percent respectively. "After a particularly strong period for Synlait and A2, they've obviously given back a little bit of their gains, and A2 continues to trade on pretty solid volumes," Linsday said. "The strength earlier in the week was partly to do with one of the Aussie brokers upgrading A2, a Goldmans analyst upgraded it to buy and put a $7.90 price target on it. There has obviously been very good demand for Synlait itself, and it's not too long since they received Chinese accreditation which helps Synlait too, but that certainly assisted this week." Fonterra Shareholders Fund units declined 2.2 percent, or 14 cents, to $6.10 after shedding rights to a 20 cents per share final dividend. Polish Dairy, the fifth largest producer of milk in the European Union, will join Fonterra Cooperative Group's Global Dairy Trade platform from Nov. 21, initially offering skim milk powder, whole milk powder, butter and lactose on the platform.

title: Technology drives Dutch dairy farm productivity
summary: 文章探讨了技术如何推动荷兰奶牛场的生产力提升。在荷兰，增加一头奶牛到牛群的成本高达3万美元，因此每一项生产指标都至关重要。文章分析了技术手段在提升农场运营效率方面的作用，这对于关注全球乳业供应链及原料生产效率的从业者具有参考价值。
author: Neal Wallace
points: 荷兰增加一头奶牛成本高达3万美元
技术手段提升奶牛场生产力
每一项生产指标都至关重要
body: It is the finer details that really matter to Mathijs Meiser and his partner Florien Bleijenberg. They, along with Meiser’s parents Bennie and Elly, run a 200 hectare family dairy farm in northwestern Netherlands, milking 350 cows three times a day all year round. Last year the herd produced 4 million litres or 11,500kg/milk/cow with 4.5% fat and 3.5% protein. Their motivation is to be as efficient as possible. “We don’t want any losses, anywhere,” Meiser said. The cows are in milk for 328 days. He is confident production could reach 12,000 to 13,000kg/milk/cow, but that would shorten their lives and require higher replacement rates. Cows first calve at 21 months of age, four months earlier than the national average. In her lifetime, Meiser said, a cow will produce 64,000kg/milk, nearly double the Netherlands average of 36,000kg/milk. Technology is essential to keep cows healthy and production high. For example, a GPS system in the farm’s tractor ensures it follows the same tramlines every time it enters a paddock, harvesting grass or making silage. By following the same wheel tracks, pasture yield is 10-15% higher. Using Nedap’s SmartTag collars and SmartSight camera monitoring for lameness, provides peace of mind with a large herd. “We can’t always be in the barn, so it tells us when there is a sick cow or something we need to look at,” Meiser said. Previously he would trim the feet of his whole herd twice a year, but SmartSight technology means he focuses only on those that need it. He said he can make money at the current milk price of NZ92 cents per litre.

title: Synlait’s Longest-Serving Employee Joins Executive Team - Rural News Group
summary: 新西兰Synlait乳业任命服务近18年的员工David Williams为乳品供应与可持续发展总经理，负责两大商业牧场、近200位奶农供应商及可持续发展工作。Williams自2008年加入时公司尚在起步阶段，如今公司经历财务波动，得益于股东Bright Dairy和A2 Milk的再投资及业务重心转移，已实现盈利。
title_zh: Synlait公司资深员工加入高管团队
points: Synlait任命任职时间最长的员工加入高管团队
乳业企业高管变动可能影响供应链运营策略
新西兰乳企人事调整是行业关注焦点
body: David Williams has been appointed general manager of milk supply and sustainability, in charge of the team of 28 people which runs Synlait’s two commercial dairy farms, supports its nearly 200 farmer suppliers and leads its sustainability workstreams. Williams jointed Synlait in March 2008 when the Dunsandel company was primarily a dairy farm owner and its first processing plant was still under construction. At that time, he explains, the company had nine dairy farms, was in the process of converting another six for the following season, and the company’s Dunsandel plant was still being kitted out with the first drier due to come online in August 2008. In the 2008-09 season it began processing milk from 60 farms, its own 15 plus another 45 contracted suppliers. “My role back then was everything to do with milk supply. I was it,” he told Dairy News . “Everything to do with all the relationships with farmers and contracting the milk, and all of the aspects relating to milk quality and RMP [Risk Management Programme] and sustainability, and all of the milk collection. “So, I started in March 2008, and there was quite a lot to do before August.” Williams’ elevation to the executive this year comes as the company is coming out of a difficult period, having reported a net loss after tax of $75.4 million for the year to July 31 2026 – but that includes a sharp turnaround of a net loss of $80.6 million for the first half of the financial year, then a net profit of $5.2 million in the second half. Williams says the company’s recent problems have been met by reinvestment by shareholders Bright Dairy and A2 Milk, and by refocusing operations on the Dunsandel plant, with all suppliers now in Canterbury. Williams says Synlait has had its ups and downs, but he has stayed through the tough times because he likes the company, what it stands for, and that it has always attracted “really good people who just want to get on with things”. He adds he also enjoys working with the farmer suppliers, who have also shown their loyalty to the company. “Most of the ones that started in 2008 are still there as well.”

summary: 恒天然公司在新西兰奶源新闻网站上发布警告，称能源中断可能对乳制品加工构成威胁。这一事件凸显了能源供应对乳制品行业的依赖性，对依赖稳定电力进行生产加工的从业者而言，能源安全成为影响生产稳定性的关键因素。乳制品加工需要大量电力支持，如挤奶、发酵、包装等环节，任何能源供应的中断都可能造成生产停滞，影响产品质量和供应稳定性。对于跨境乳制品行业从业者来说，关注能源供应的稳定性，并制定应急预案，是保障供应链安全的重要措施之一。

points: 能源中断威胁乳制品加工
